passages.original: O, yet I do repent me of my fury, That I did kill them.
passages.vernacular: 啊,不過我後悔我嘅暴怒,殺咗佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,可是我後悔我的暴怒,殺了他們。

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: Wherefore did you so?
passages.vernacular: 你點解嗰樣做?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你為什麼那樣做?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Who can be wise, amaz’d, temperate, and furious, Loyal and neutral, in a moment? No man: Th’ expedition of my violent love Outrun the pauser, reason. Here lay Duncan, His silver skin lac’d with his golden blood; And his gash’d stabs look’d like a breach in nature For ruin’s wasteful entrance: there, the murderers, Steep’d in the colours of their trade, their daggers Unmannerly breech’d with gore. Who could refrain, That had a heart to love, and in that heart Courage to make’s love known?
passages.vernacular: 邊個能喺一瞬間既明智又驚愕、既節制又暴怒、既忠誠又中立?冇人:我猛烈嘅愛嘅急迫,跑喺遲疑者——理智——前面。鄧肯躺喺呢度,佢嘅銀色皮膚鑲住金色嘅血;佢嗰啲張開嘅刀傷像係自然嘅缺口,供毀滅浪費地闖入:喺嗰度係兇手哋,浸喺佢哋行業嘅顏色裡,佢哋嘅匕首不雅地套住血汙。邊個能忍住,如果佢有一顆愛嘅心,而且嗰心裡有勇氣表明佢嘅愛?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰能在一瞬間既明智又驚愕、既節制又暴怒、既忠誠又中立?沒有人:我猛烈的愛的急迫,跑在遲疑者——理智——前面。鄧肯躺在這裡,他的銀色皮膚鑲著金色的血;他那些張開的刀傷像是自然的缺口,供毀滅浪費地闖入:在那裡是兇手們,浸在他們行業的顏色裡,他們的匕首不雅地套著血汙。誰能忍住,如果他有一顆愛的心,而且那心裡有勇氣表明他的愛?

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Help me hence, ho!
passages.vernacular: 扶我出去,喂!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 扶我出去,喂!

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: Look to the lady.
passages.vernacular: 照顧夫人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 照顧夫人。

passages.title: Malcolm 馬爾康
passages.original: Why do we hold our tongues, That most may claim this argument for ours?
passages.vernacular: 我哋點解不講話,最有權利認呢件事為我哋嘅人?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們為什麼不說話,最有權利認這件事為我們的人?

passages.title: Donalbain 唐納本
passages.original: What should be spoken here, where our fate, Hid in an auger hole, may rush, and seize us? Let’s away. Our tears are not yet brew’d.
passages.vernacular: 喺呢度該講乜嘢,我哋嘅命運藏喺鑽孔裡,隨時會衝出嚟抓住我哋?我哋走吧。我哋嘅眼淚仲冇釀成。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在這裡該說什麼,我們的命運藏在鑽孔裡,隨時會衝出來抓住我們?我們走吧。我們的眼淚還沒釀成。

passages.title: Malcolm 馬爾康
passages.original: Nor our strong sorrow Upon the foot of motion.
passages.vernacular: 我哋強烈嘅悲傷都仲冇付諸行動。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們強烈的悲傷也還沒付諸行動。

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: Look to the lady:—
passages.vernacular: 照顧夫人:——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 照顧夫人:——

passages.original: [Lady Macbeth is carried out.]
passages.vernacular: [馬克白夫人被扶下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [馬克白夫人被扶下。]

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: And when we have our naked frailties hid, That suffer in exposure, let us meet, And question this most bloody piece of work To know it further. Fears and scruples shake us: In the great hand of God I stand; and thence Against the undivulg’d pretence I fight Of treasonous malice.
passages.vernacular: 等我哋把受唔得外露嘅赤裸脆弱遮蓋好,讓我哋會面,追問呢個最血腥嘅事,進一步弄清楚。恐懼同疑慮動搖住我哋:我立足於上帝嘅偉大之手;並從嗰度對抗叛逆惡意尚未揭露嘅圖謀。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 等我們把受不得外露的赤裸脆弱遮蓋好,讓我們會面,追問這最血腥的事,進一步弄清楚。恐懼和疑慮動搖著我們:我立足於上帝的偉大之手;並從那裡對抗叛逆惡意尚未揭露的圖謀。

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: And so do I.
passages.vernacular: 我都一樣。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我也一樣。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: So all.
passages.vernacular: 大家都係。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 大家都是。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Let’s briefly put on manly readiness, And meet i’ th’ hall together.
passages.vernacular: 讓我哋迅速穿上男子漢嘅準備,到大廳一起會面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓我們迅速穿上男子漢的準備,到大廳一起會面。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Well contented.
passages.vernacular: 好同意。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 非常同意。

passages.original: [Exeunt all but Malcolm and Donalbain.]
passages.vernacular: [除馬爾康同唐納本外,眾人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [除馬爾康和唐納本外,眾人下。]

passages.title: Malcolm 馬爾康
passages.original: What will you do? Let’s not consort with them: To show an unfelt sorrow is an office Which the false man does easy. I’ll to England.
passages.vernacular: 你打算點算?我哋別同佢哋為伍:表現不曾感到嘅悲傷,係虛偽嘅人輕易就做嘅事。我去英格蘭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你打算怎麼辦?我們別與他們為伍:表現不曾感到的悲傷,是虛偽的人輕易就做的事。我去英格蘭。

passages.title: Donalbain 唐納本
passages.original: To Ireland, I. Our separated fortune Shall keep us both the safer. Where we are, There’s daggers in men’s smiles: the near in blood, The nearer bloody.
passages.vernacular: 我去愛爾蘭。我哋分開嘅命運會讓我哋兩人更安全。我哋所在嘅地方,人哋嘅微笑裡藏住匕首:血緣越近,越係血腥。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我去愛爾蘭。我們分開的命運會讓我們兩人更安全。我們所在的地方,人們的微笑裡藏著匕首:血緣越近,越是血腥。

passages.title: Malcolm 馬爾康
passages.original: This murderous shaft that’s shot Hath not yet lighted; and our safest way Is to avoid the aim. Therefore to horse; And let us not be dainty of leave-taking, But shift away. There’s warrant in that theft Which steals itself, when there’s no mercy left.
passages.vernacular: 呢支謀殺嘅箭射出後仲冇落地;我哋最安全嘅辦法係避開瞄準。所以上馬;別拘泥告別禮節,趕快溜走。偷偷溜走係有道理嘅,當憐憫已不存在時。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這支謀殺的箭射出後還沒落地;我們最安全的辦法是避開瞄準。所以上馬;別拘泥告別禮節,趕快溜走。偷偷溜走是有道理的,當憐憫已不存在時。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act II, Scene IV — Without the Castle 第二幕第四場:城堡外

passages.original: Enter Ross and an Old Man.
passages.vernacular: [羅斯同一位老人上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [羅斯和一位老人上。]

passages.title: Old Man 老人
passages.original: Threescore and ten I can remember well, Within the volume of which time I have seen Hours dreadful and things strange, but this sore night Hath trifled former knowings.
passages.vernacular: 七十年嘅事我記得好清楚,喺呢段時間裡我見過可怕嘅時辰同奇怪嘅事,但呢個痛苦嘅夜晚使以前所知嘅都成咗兒戲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 七十年的事我記得很清楚,在這段時間裡我見過可怕的時辰和奇怪的事,但這個痛苦的夜晚使以前所知的都成了兒戲。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Ha, good father, Thou seest the heavens, as troubled with man’s act, Threatens his bloody stage: by the clock ’tis day, And yet dark night strangles the travelling lamp. Is’t night’s predominance, or the day’s shame, That darkness does the face of earth entomb, When living light should kiss it?
passages.vernacular: 啊,好父親,你睇天空像被人嘅行為所困擾,威脅住佢血腥嘅舞台:按鐘點係白天,不過黑夜卻扼殺咗行進嘅明燈。係夜嘅優勢,定係白日嘅羞恥,使黑暗把大地嘅臉埋葬,而本該係活嘅光去親吻佢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,好父親,你看天空像被人的行為所困擾,威脅著他血腥的舞台:按鐘點是白天,可是黑夜卻扼殺了行進的明燈。是夜的優勢,還是白日的羞恥,使黑暗把大地的臉埋葬,而本該是活的光去親吻它?

passages.title: Old Man 老人
passages.original: ’Tis unnatural, Even like the deed that’s done. On Tuesday last, A falcon, towering in her pride of place, Was by a mousing owl hawk’d at and kill’d.
passages.vernacular: 呢不自然,正像所做嘅事一樣。上星期二,一隻傲然高飛嘅獵鷹,被一隻捕鼠嘅貓頭鷹襲擊殺死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不自然,正像所做的事一樣。上星期二,一隻傲然高飛的獵鷹,被一隻捕鼠的貓頭鷹襲擊殺死。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: And Duncan’s horses (a thing most strange and certain) Beauteous and swift, the minions of their race, Turn’d wild in nature, broke their stalls, flung out, Contending ’gainst obedience, as they would make War with mankind.
passages.vernacular: 仲有鄧肯嘅馬(一件極奇怪而確實嘅事),美麗迅捷,係牠哋種類中嘅寵兒,變得野性,衝破馬廄跑出去,抗拒服從,彷彿要同人類開戰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有鄧肯的馬(一件極奇怪而確實的事),美麗迅捷,是牠們種類中的寵兒,變得野性,衝破馬廄跑出去,抗拒服從,彷彿要與人類開戰。

passages.title: Old Man 老人
passages.original: ’Tis said they eat each other.
passages.vernacular: 據講牠哋互相吞食。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 據說牠們互相吞食。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: They did so; to the amazement of mine eyes, That look’d upon’t. Here comes the good Macduff.
passages.vernacular: 確實如此;讓睇到嘅我驚愕不已。好麥克德夫嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 確實如此;讓看到的我驚愕不已。好麥克德夫來了。

passages.original: Enter Macduff.
passages.vernacular: [麥克德夫上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [麥克德夫上。]

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: How goes the world, sir, now?
passages.vernacular: 而家世道如何,先生?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在世道如何,先生?

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: Why, see you not?
passages.vernacular: 哎,你冇睇見嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,你沒看見嗎?

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Is’t known who did this more than bloody deed?
passages.vernacular: 知道係邊個幹咗呢比血腥更甚嘅事嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 知道是誰幹了這比血腥更甚的事嗎?

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: Those that Macbeth hath slain.
passages.vernacular: 係馬克白殺咗嘅嗰啲人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是馬克白殺了的那些人。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Alas, the day! What good could they pretend?
passages.vernacular: 唉,呢一天!佢哋能圖乜嘢好處?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 唉,這一天!他們能圖什麼好處?

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: They were suborn’d. Malcolm and Donalbain, the King’s two sons, Are stol’n away and fled; which puts upon them Suspicion of the deed.
passages.vernacular: 佢哋被收買喇。馬爾康同唐納本,國王嘅兩個兒子,偷偷逃走喇;呢使佢哋蒙上咗呢事嘅嫌疑。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們被收買了。馬爾康和唐納本,國王的兩個兒子,偷偷逃走了;這使他們蒙上了這事的嫌疑。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: ’Gainst nature still: Thriftless ambition, that will ravin up Thine own life’s means!—Then ’tis most like The sovereignty will fall upon Macbeth.
passages.vernacular: 定係違反天性:不顧後果嘅野心,連自己生命嘅來源都要吞噬!——咁好可能王權要落到馬克白身上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還是違反天性:不顧後果的野心,連自己生命的來源都要吞噬!——那麼很可能王權要落到馬克白身上。

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: He is already nam’d; and gone to Scone To be invested.
passages.vernacular: 佢已被推舉;並已去斯貢受封。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他已被推舉;並已去斯貢受封。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Where is Duncan’s body?
passages.vernacular: 鄧肯嘅遺體喺邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 鄧肯的遺體在哪裡?

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: Carried to Colmekill, The sacred storehouse of his predecessors, And guardian of their bones.
passages.vernacular: 被運到科爾姆基爾,嗰個係佢先王哋神聖嘅貯藏庫,睇守住佢哋嘅遺骨。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 被運到科爾姆基爾,那是他先王們神聖的貯藏庫,看守著他們的遺骨。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Will you to Scone?
passages.vernacular: 你要去斯貢嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你要去斯貢嗎?

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: No, cousin, I’ll to Fife.
passages.vernacular: 不,堂兄,我去法夫。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 不,堂兄,我去法夫。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Well, I will thither.
passages.vernacular: 好,我去嗰度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,我去那裡。

passages.title: Macduff 麥克德夫
passages.original: Well, may you see things well done there. Adieu! Lest our old robes sit easier than our new!
passages.vernacular: 好,願你喺嗰度睇見事事順利。再見!免得我哋嘅舊袍比新袍更合身!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,願你在那裡看見事事順利。再見!免得我們的舊袍比新袍更合身!

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Farewell, father.
passages.vernacular: 再會,父親。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 再會,父親。

passages.title: Old Man 老人
passages.original: God’s benison go with you; and with those That would make good of bad, and friends of foes!
passages.vernacular: 願上帝嘅祝福同你同喺,都同嗰啲要化惡為善、化敵為友嘅人同喺!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願上帝的祝福與你同在,也與那些要化惡為善、化敵為友的人同在!

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene I — Forres. A Room in the Palace 第三幕第一場:福里斯王宮一室

passages.original: Enter Banquo.
passages.vernacular: [班柯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [班柯上。]

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: Thou hast it now, King, Cawdor, Glamis, all, As the Weird Women promis’d; and, I fear, Thou play’dst most foully for’t; yet it was said It should not stand in thy posterity; But that myself should be the root and father Of many kings. If there come truth from them (As upon thee, Macbeth, their speeches shine) Why, by the verities on thee made good, May they not be my oracles as well, And set me up in hope? But hush; no more.
passages.vernacular: 你而家全有喇:國王、考多、葛萊密斯,一切如女巫所許諾嘅;我怕你為此玩得極其卑鄙;然而據講呢唔會傳畀你嘅子孫;而係我將成為許多君王嘅根源同始祖。如果佢哋嘅話有真,(正如對你,馬克白,佢哋嘅話已應驗)咁,既然佢哋對你講嘅都成真喇,佢哋對我嘅預言不都可以係神諭,畀我希望嗎?不過噓;唔好再講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你現在全有了:國王、考多、葛萊密斯,一切如女巫所許諾的;我怕你為此玩得極其卑鄙;然而據說這不會傳給你的子孫;而是我將成為許多君王的根源和始祖。如果她們的話有真,(正如對你,馬克白,她們的話已應驗)那麼,既然她們對你說的都成真了,她們對我的預言不也可以是神諭,給我希望嗎?不過噓;別再說。

passages.original: Sennet sounded. Enter Macbeth as King, Lady Macbeth as Queen; Lennox, Ross, Lords, and Attendants.
passages.vernacular: [奏樂。馬克白以國王身分、馬克白夫人以王后身分,偕倫諾克斯、羅斯、群臣同侍從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [奏樂。馬克白以國王身分、馬克白夫人以王后身分,偕倫諾克斯、羅斯、群臣與侍從上。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Here’s our chief guest.
passages.vernacular: 呢個係我哋嘅主賓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是我們的主賓。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: If he had been forgotten, It had been as a gap in our great feast, And all-thing unbecoming.
passages.vernacular: 如果忘咗佢,就會像我哋盛宴中嘅缺口,好不妥。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 如果忘了他,就會像我們盛宴中的缺口,十分不妥。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Tonight we hold a solemn supper, sir, And I’ll request your presence.
passages.vernacular: 今晚我哋舉行隆重嘅晚宴,先生,我請你出席。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 今晚我們舉行隆重的晚宴,先生,我請你出席。

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: Let your Highness Command upon me, to the which my duties Are with a most indissoluble tie For ever knit.
passages.vernacular: 請陛下吩咐我,我嘅職責永遠以不可解嘅紐帶繫喺嗰上面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請陛下吩咐我,我的職責永遠以不可解的紐帶繫在那上面。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Ride you this afternoon?
passages.vernacular: 你今日下午騎馬嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你今天下午騎馬嗎?

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: Ay, my good lord.
passages.vernacular: 係,我嘅好陛下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,我的好陛下。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: We should have else desir’d your good advice (Which still hath been both grave and prosperous) In this day’s council; but we’ll take tomorrow. Is’t far you ride?
passages.vernacular: 否則我哋本想喺今日嘅會議上聽取你嘅好建議(嗰一向既持重又順利);不過我哋聽日再請教。你騎得遠嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 否則我們本想在今天的會議上聽取你的好建議(那一向既持重又順利);不過我們明天再請教。你騎得遠嗎?

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: As far, my lord, as will fill up the time ’Twixt this and supper: go not my horse the better, I must become a borrower of the night, For a dark hour or twain.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,遠到剛好填滿從而家到晚宴之間嘅時間:要係我嘅馬跑得唔夠好,我得向夜晚借一兩個黑暗嘅鐘頭。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,遠到剛好填滿從現在到晚宴之間的時間:要是我的馬跑得不夠好,我得向夜晚借一兩個黑暗的鐘頭。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Fail not our feast.
passages.vernacular: 別誤咗我哋嘅宴會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別誤了我們的宴會。

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: My lord, I will not.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,我唔會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,我不會。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: We hear our bloody cousins are bestow’d In England and in Ireland; not confessing Their cruel parricide, filling their hearers With strange invention. But of that tomorrow, When therewithal we shall have cause of state Craving us jointly. Hie you to horse: adieu, Till you return at night. Goes Fleance with you?
passages.vernacular: 我哋聽講我哋嗰啲血腥嘅堂兄弟安身喺英格蘭同愛爾蘭;佢哋不承認自己殘忍嘅弒父罪行,卻用奇怪嘅編造充塞聽者嘅耳朵。不過呢啲聽日再講,到時我哋會有國事需要共同商議。快上馬:再見,等你晚上回嚟。弗里恩斯同你同去嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們聽說我們那些血腥的堂兄弟安身在英格蘭和愛爾蘭;他們不承認自己殘忍的弒父罪行,卻用奇怪的編造充塞聽者的耳朵。不過這些明天再說,到時我們會有國事需要共同商議。快上馬:再見,等你晚上回來。弗里恩斯與你同去嗎?

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: Ay, my good lord: our time does call upon’s.
passages.vernacular: 係,我嘅好陛下:時間喺催我哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,我的好陛下:時間在催我們。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: I wish your horses swift and sure of foot; And so I do commend you to their backs. Farewell.—
passages.vernacular: 我祝你嘅馬又快又穩;我把你託付畀牠哋嘅背。再會。——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我祝你的馬又快又穩;我把你託付給牠們的背。再會。——

passages.original: [Exit Banquo.]
passages.vernacular: [班柯下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [班柯下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Let every man be master of his time Till seven at night; to make society The sweeter welcome, we will keep ourself Till supper time alone: while then, God be with you.
passages.vernacular: 讓每個人喺晚上七點以前自己支配時間;為了讓社交更受歡迎,我哋自己要獨處到晚宴時間:喺嗰之前,上帝同你哋同喺。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓每個人在晚上七點以前自己支配時間;為了讓社交更受歡迎,我們自己要獨處到晚宴時間:在那之前,上帝與你們同在。

passages.original: [Exeunt Lady Macbeth, Lords, &c.]
passages.vernacular: [馬克白夫人、群臣等下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [馬克白夫人、群臣等下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Sirrah, a word with you. Attend those men Our pleasure?
passages.vernacular: 喂,有句話跟你講。嗰啲人喺等候我哋嘅吩咐嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 喂,有句話跟你說。那些人在等候我們的吩咐嗎?

passages.title: Servant 僕人
passages.original: They are, my lord, without the palace gate.
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,陛下,佢哋喺宮門外。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,陛下,他們在宮門外。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Bring them before us.
passages.vernacular: 帶佢哋到我哋面前嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 帶他們到我們面前來。

passages.original: [Exit Servant.]
passages.vernacular: [僕人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [僕人下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: To be thus is nothing, But to be safely thus. Our fears in Banquo Stick deep, and in his royalty of nature Reigns that which would be fear’d: ’tis much he dares; And, to that dauntless temper of his mind, He hath a wisdom that doth guide his valour To act in safety. There is none but he Whose being I do fear: and under him My genius is rebuk’d; as, it is said, Mark Antony’s was by Caesar. He chid the sisters When first they put the name of king upon me, And bade them speak to him; then, prophet-like, They hail’d him father to a line of kings: Upon my head they plac’d a fruitless crown, And put a barren sceptre in my gripe, Thence to be wrench’d with an unlineal hand, No son of mine succeeding. If’t be so, For Banquo’s issue have I fil’d my mind; For them the gracious Duncan have I murder’d; Put rancours in the vessel of my peace Only for them; and mine eternal jewel Given to the common enemy of man, To make them kings, the seed of Banquo kings! Rather than so, come, fate, into the list, And champion me to th’ utterance!—Who’s there?—
passages.vernacular: 僅僅咁樣係冇意義嘅,必須安穩地咁樣才行。我哋對班柯嘅恐懼扎得好深,佢天性中嘅王者氣度主宰住嗰令人畏懼嘅嘢:佢敢作敢為,呢個好咗唔得;而且喺佢無畏嘅氣質之外,佢有一種智慧指引佢嘅勇氣安全行事。除咗佢,冇人嘅存在使我害怕:喺佢面前,我嘅守護神被壓制;就像據講馬克·安東尼嘅守護神被凱撒壓制一樣。當姊妹哋最初把國王嘅名號加喺我身上時,佢斥責咗佢哋,命令佢哋對佢講話;然後,佢哋像先知一樣,稱佢為一代君王之父:佢哋喺我頭上放咗一頂無果嘅王冠,喺我手裡放咗一根無子嗣嘅權杖,要被外姓嘅手奪走,冇我嘅兒子繼位。如果係咁樣,我係為班柯嘅子孫玷污咗我嘅心;為佢哋,我謀殺咗仁慈嘅鄧肯;只為佢哋,喺我安寧嘅杯中倒進怨毒;仲把我永恆嘅寶石交畀人類共同嘅敵人,為了使佢哋成為君王,班柯嘅後代做君王!同其如此,嚟吧,命運,進入競技場,同我決鬥到底!——邊個喺嗰度?——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 僅僅這樣是沒有意義的,必須安穩地這樣才行。我們對班柯的恐懼扎得很深,他天性中的王者氣度主宰著那令人畏懼的東西:他敢作敢為,這很了不得;而且在他無畏的氣質之外,他有一種智慧指引他的勇氣安全行事。除了他,沒有人的存在使我害怕:在他面前,我的守護神被壓制;就像據說馬克·安東尼的守護神被凱撒壓制一樣。當姊妹們最初把國王的名號加在我身上時,他斥責了她們,命令她們對他說話;然後,她們像先知一樣,稱他為一代君王之父:她們在我頭上放了一頂無果的王冠,在我手裡放了一根無子嗣的權杖,要被外姓的手奪走,沒有我的兒子繼位。如果是這樣,我是為班柯的子孫玷污了我的心;為他們,我謀殺了仁慈的鄧肯;只為他們,在我安寧的杯中倒進怨毒;還把我永恆的寶石交給人類共同的敵人,為了使他們成為君王,班柯的後代做君王!與其如此,來吧,命運,進入競技場,與我決鬥到底!——誰在那裡?——

passages.original: Enter Servant with two Murderers.
passages.vernacular: [僕人帶兩個刺客上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [僕人帶兩個刺客上。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Now go to the door, and stay there till we call.
passages.vernacular: 而家到門口去,等我哋叫你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 現在到門口去,等我們叫你。

passages.original: [Exit Servant.]
passages.vernacular: [僕人下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [僕人下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Was it not yesterday we spoke together?
passages.vernacular: 我哋唔係尋日談過話嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們不是昨天談過話嗎?

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: It was, so please your Highness.
passages.vernacular: 係嘅,蒙陛下恩准。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是的,蒙陛下恩准。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Well then, now Have you consider’d of my speeches? Know That it was he, in the times past, which held you So under fortune, which you thought had been Our innocent self? This I made good to you In our last conference, pass’d in probation with you How you were borne in hand, how cross’d, the instruments, Who wrought with them, and all things else that might To half a soul and to a notion craz’d Say, “Thus did Banquo.”
passages.vernacular: 好,咁而家,你哋考慮過我嘅話咗嗎?要知道,從前使你哋如此唔得志嘅係佢,而你哋仲以為係我哋無辜嘅自己?呢啲我喺上次會談中已向你哋證實,同你哋一起審驗過你哋如何被愚弄、如何被阻撓、係乜嘢工具、邊個同佢哋合謀,以及其他一切能讓半個靈魂、一顆瘋癲頭腦都講「呢個係班柯幹嘅」嘅事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,那麼現在,你們考慮過我的話了嗎?要知道,從前使你們如此不得志的是他,而你們還以為是我們無辜的自己?這一點我在上次會談中已向你們證實,和你們一起審驗過你們如何被愚弄、如何被阻撓、是什麼工具、誰與他們合謀,以及其他一切能讓半個靈魂、一顆瘋癲頭腦也說「這是班柯幹的」的事。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: You made it known to us.
passages.vernacular: 你已讓我哋知道喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你已讓我們知道了。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: I did so; and went further, which is now Our point of second meeting. Do you find Your patience so predominant in your nature, That you can let this go? Are you so gospell’d, To pray for this good man and for his issue, Whose heavy hand hath bow’d you to the grave, And beggar’d yours forever?
passages.vernacular: 我係咁樣做喇;仲進一步,呢個就係我哋第二次會面嘅要點。你哋嘅忍耐喺天性中咁樣占上風,能放過呢件事嗎?你哋咁樣篤信福音,要為呢個好人同佢嘅子孫祈禱,而佢沉重嘅手把你哋壓向墳墓,使你哋嘅家永遠貧困?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是這樣做了;還進一步,這就是我們第二次會面的要點。你們的忍耐在天性中這樣占上風,能放過這件事嗎?你們這樣篤信福音,要為這個好人和他的子孫祈禱,而他沉重的手把你們壓向墳墓,使你們的家永遠貧困?

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: We are men, my liege.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,我哋係人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,我們是人。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Ay, in the catalogue ye go for men; As hounds, and greyhounds, mongrels, spaniels, curs, Shoughs, water-rugs, and demi-wolves are clept All by the name of dogs: the valu’d file Distinguishes the swift, the slow, the subtle, The housekeeper, the hunter, every one According to the gift which bounteous nature Hath in him clos’d; whereby he does receive Particular addition, from the bill That writes them all alike: and so of men. Now, if you have a station in the file, Not i’ th’ worst rank of manhood, say’t; And I will put that business in your bosoms, Whose execution takes your enemy off, Grapples you to the heart and love of us, Who wear our health but sickly in his life, Which in his death were perfect.
passages.vernacular: 對,喺名冊上你哋算係人;就像獵犬、靈緹、雜種狗、長毛犬、土狗、水狗、半狼狗,都被一概稱為狗:但有價值嘅名冊會區分邊啲快、邊啲慢、邊啲機靈、邊啲睇家、邊啲打獵,每一隻依據慷慨嘅自然賦予牠嘅天賦;因此牠得到特別嘅稱號,有別於把牠哋一律寫成一樣嘅清單:人都係如此。而家,如果你哋喺名冊上有一個位置,不喺人類最差嘅一等,就講出嚟;我就把一件事放進你哋心裡,佢嘅執行會除去你哋嘅敵人,把你哋緊緊綁喺我哋嘅心同愛上,我哋因佢活住而病懨懨,佢一死我哋才完整。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,在名冊上你們算是人;就像獵犬、靈緹、雜種狗、長毛犬、土狗、水狗、半狼狗,都被一概稱為狗:但有價值的名冊會區分哪些快、哪些慢、哪些機靈、哪些看家、哪些打獵,每一隻依據慷慨的自然賦予牠的天賦;因此牠得到特別的稱號,有別於把牠們一律寫成一樣的清單:人也是如此。現在,如果你們在名冊上有一個位置,不在人類最差的一等,就說出來;我就把一件事放進你們心裡,它的執行會除去你們的敵人,把你們緊緊綁在我們的心與愛上,我們因他活著而病懨懨,他一死我們才完整。

passages.title: Second Murderer 第二刺客
passages.original: I am one, my liege, Whom the vile blows and buffets of the world Hath so incens’d that I am reckless what I do to spite the world.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,我係咁樣一個人,世界嘅惡毒打擊同折磨使我極其憤怒,為了對世界洩憤,我不顧後果。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,我是這樣一個人,世界的惡毒打擊和折磨使我極其憤怒,為了對世界洩憤,我不顧後果。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: And I another, So weary with disasters, tugg’d with fortune, That I would set my life on any chance, To mend it or be rid on’t.
passages.vernacular: 我係另一個,被災禍弄得咁樣疲憊,被命運拉扯,為了改善或擺脫佢,我願把性命押喺任何機會上。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是另一個,被災禍弄得這樣疲憊,被命運拉扯,為了改善或擺脫它,我願把性命押在任何機會上。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Both of you Know Banquo was your enemy.
passages.vernacular: 你哋兩個都知道班柯係你哋嘅敵人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們兩個都知道班柯是你們的敵人。

passages.title: Both Murderers 兩個刺客
passages.original: True, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 真嘅,陛下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的,陛下。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: So is he mine; and in such bloody distance, That every minute of his being thrusts Against my near’st of life; and though I could With barefac’d power sweep him from my sight, And bid my will avouch it, yet I must not, For certain friends that are both his and mine, Whose loves I may not drop, but wail his fall Who I myself struck down: and thence it is That I to your assistance do make love, Masking the business from the common eye For sundry weighty reasons.
passages.vernacular: 佢都係我嘅敵人;而且喺呢血腥嘅距離上,佢存在嘅每一分鐘都戳向我最接近生命嘅地方;雖然我可以公然用權力把佢從我眼前掃除,講呢個係我嘅意願,但我唔能夠,因為有些朋友既係佢嘅又係我嘅,我唔能夠丟棄佢哋嘅愛,仲得為我親手打倒嘅人哭泣:因此我才向你哋求助,把呢件事瞞過眾人嘅眼睛,有幾個重大嘅原因。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他也是我的敵人;而且在這血腥的距離上,他存在的每一分鐘都戳向我最接近生命的地方;雖然我可以公然用權力把他從我眼前掃除,說這是我的意願,但我不能,因為有些朋友既是他的又是我的,我不能丟棄他們的愛,還得為我親手打倒的人哭泣:因此我才向你們求助,把這件事瞞過眾人的眼睛,有幾個重大的原因。

passages.title: Second Murderer 第二刺客
passages.original: We shall, my lord, Perform what you command us.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,我哋會執行您嘅命令。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,我們會執行您的命令。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: Though our lives—
passages.vernacular: 雖然我哋嘅性命——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 雖然我們的性命——

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Your spirits shine through you. Within this hour at most, I will advise you where to plant yourselves, Acquaint you with the perfect spy o’ th’ time, The moment on’t; for’t must be done tonight And something from the palace; always thought That I require a clearness. And with him (To leave no rubs nor botches in the work) Fleance his son, that keeps him company, Whose absence is no less material to me Than is his father’s, must embrace the fate Of that dark hour. Resolve yourselves apart. I’ll come to you anon.
passages.vernacular: 你哋嘅精神透出光嚟喇。至多一小時內,我會告訴你哋該埋伏喺邊度,讓你哋知道最準確嘅時機;因為必須今晚動手,而且離宮殿有一段距離;始終要記住,我要求乾淨俐落。仲有佢(為了不留下任何障礙或敗筆),佢嘅兒子弗里恩斯,同佢同行,佢嘅缺席對我嘅重要不亞於佢父親,都必須迎接嗰黑暗時刻嘅命運。你哋到旁邊商量決定。我即刻嚟找你哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們的精神透出光來了。至多一小時內,我會告訴你們該埋伏在哪裡,讓你們知道最準確的時機;因為必須今晚動手,而且離宮殿有一段距離;始終要記住,我要求乾淨俐落。還有他(為了不留下任何障礙或敗筆),他的兒子弗里恩斯,與他同行,他的缺席對我的重要不亞於他父親,也必須迎接那黑暗時刻的命運。你們到旁邊商量決定。我馬上來找你們。

passages.title: Both Murderers 兩個刺客
passages.original: We are resolv’d, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,我哋決定喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,我們決定了。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: I’ll call upon you straight: abide within.
passages.vernacular: 我即刻就叫你哋:待喺裡面。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我立刻就叫你們:待在裡面。

passages.original: [Exeunt Murderers.]
passages.vernacular: [刺客哋下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [刺客們下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: It is concluded. Banquo, thy soul’s flight, If it find heaven, must find it out tonight.
passages.vernacular: 事情決定喇。班柯,你靈魂嘅飛升,如果能找到天堂,就必須喺今晚找到。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 事情決定了。班柯,你靈魂的飛升,如果能找到天堂,就必須在今晚找到。

passages.original: [Exit.]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene II — Another Room in the Palace 第三幕第二場:王宮另一室

passages.original: Enter Lady Macbeth and a Servant.
passages.vernacular: [馬克白夫人同一名僕人上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [馬克白夫人和一名僕人上。]

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Is Banquo gone from court?
passages.vernacular: 班柯離開宮廷咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 班柯離開宮廷了嗎?

passages.title: Servant 僕人
passages.original: Ay, madam, but returns again tonight.
passages.vernacular: 係,夫人,但今晚會回嚟。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,夫人,但今晚會回來。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Say to the King, I would attend his leisure For a few words.
passages.vernacular: 去對國王講,我想趁佢有空講幾句話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 去對國王說,我想趁他有空說幾句話。

passages.title: Servant 僕人
passages.original: Madam, I will.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,我呢就去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,我這就去。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Naught’s had, all’s spent, Where our desire is got without content: ’Tis safer to be that which we destroy, Than by destruction dwell in doubtful joy.
passages.vernacular: 一無所得,一切耗盡,當我哋嘅慾望得到咗卻不滿足:成為我哋所毀滅嘅人,比因毀滅而生活喺不安嘅歡樂中更安全。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一無所得,一切耗盡,當我們的慾望得到了卻不滿足:成為我們所毀滅的人,比因毀滅而生活在不安的歡樂中更安全。

passages.original: Enter Macbeth.
passages.vernacular: [馬克白上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [馬克白上。]

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: How now, my lord, why do you keep alone, Of sorriest fancies your companions making, Using those thoughts which should indeed have died With them they think on? Things without all remedy Should be without regard: what’s done is done.
passages.vernacular: 點喇,我嘅陛下,點解獨自一人,以最悲慘嘅幻想為伴,沉溺於嗰啲本該隨佢哋所想嘅人一同死去嘅念頭?無法補救嘅事就該不去理會:已做嘅就已做喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,我的陛下,為什麼獨自一人,以最悲慘的幻想為伴,沉溺於那些本該隨它們所想的人一同死去的念頭?無法補救的事就該不去理會:已做的就已做了。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: We have scorch’d the snake, not kill’d it. She’ll close, and be herself; whilst our poor malice Remains in danger of her former tooth. But let the frame of things disjoint, Both the worlds suffer, Ere we will eat our meal in fear, and sleep In the affliction of these terrible dreams That shake us nightly. Better be with the dead, Whom we, to gain our peace, have sent to peace, Than on the torture of the mind to lie In restless ecstasy. Duncan is in his grave; After life’s fitful fever he sleeps well; Treason has done his worst: nor steel, nor poison, Malice domestic, foreign levy, nothing Can touch him further.
passages.vernacular: 我哋只係燙傷咗蛇,並冇殺死佢。佢會癒合,恢復原樣;而我哋可憐嘅惡意仍喺佢昔日毒牙嘅威脅之下。但寧可讓萬物嘅結構崩解,兩個世界都受苦,都唔好我哋喺恐懼中進餐,喺呢啲每夜震撼我哋嘅可怕夢魘嘅折磨中瞓覺。寧可同死者喺一起,我哋為求自己嘅平安把佢哋送去平安,都唔好躺喺心靈嘅酷刑架上,喺唔得安息嘅狂亂中。鄧肯喺佢嘅墳墓裡;經過生命斷斷續續嘅熱病,佢瞓得好好;叛逆已盡其所能:無論鋼刀、毒藥、家賊、外兵,乜嘢都唔能夠再碰到佢喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們只是燙傷了蛇,並沒有殺死它。它會癒合,恢復原樣;而我們可憐的惡意仍在它昔日毒牙的威脅之下。但寧可讓萬物的結構崩解,兩個世界都受苦,也不要我們在恐懼中進餐,在這些每夜震撼我們的可怕夢魘的折磨中睡覺。寧可與死者在一起,我們為求自己的平安把他們送去平安,也不要躺在心靈的酷刑架上,在不得安息的狂亂中。鄧肯在他的墳墓裡;經過生命斷斷續續的熱病,他睡得很好;叛逆已盡其所能:無論鋼刀、毒藥、家賊、外兵,什麼都不能再碰到他了。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Come on, Gently my lord, sleek o’er your rugged looks; Be bright and jovial among your guests tonight.
passages.vernacular: 嚟吧,溫柔嘅陛下,撫平你皺緊嘅臉色;今晚喺客人中間要明朗愉快。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來吧,溫柔的陛下,撫平你皺緊的臉色;今晚在客人中間要明朗愉快。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: So shall I, love; and so, I pray, be you. Let your remembrance apply to Banquo; Present him eminence, both with eye and tongue: Unsafe the while, that we Must lave our honours in these flattering streams, And make our faces vizards to our hearts, Disguising what they are.
passages.vernacular: 我會嘅,愛人;都請你咁樣。讓你嘅記憶多關注班柯;對佢以眼同舌表示尊崇:喺此期間我哋並不安全,必須喺呢啲諂媚嘅溪流中洗我哋嘅榮譽,把我哋嘅臉變成心嘅面具,掩蓋佢哋嘅本來面目。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我會的,愛人;也請你這樣。讓你的記憶多關注班柯;對他以眼和舌表示尊崇:在此期間我們並不安全,必須在這些諂媚的溪流中洗我們的榮譽,把我們的臉變成心的面具,掩蓋它們的本來面目。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: You must leave this.
passages.vernacular: 你必須放下呢個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你必須放下這個。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: O, full of scorpions is my mind, dear wife! Thou know’st that Banquo, and his Fleance, lives.
passages.vernacular: 啊,我嘅心裡滿係蠍子,親愛嘅妻子!你知道班柯同佢嘅弗里恩斯仲活住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,我的心裡滿是蠍子,親愛的妻子!你知道班柯和他的弗里恩斯還活著。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: But in them nature’s copy’s not eterne.
passages.vernacular: 但喺佢哋身上,大自然嘅版權唔係永恆嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 但在他們身上,大自然的版權不是永恆的。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: There’s comfort yet; they are assailable. Then be thou jocund. Ere the bat hath flown His cloister’d flight, ere to black Hecate’s summons The shard-born beetle, with his drowsy hums, Hath rung night’s yawning peal, there shall be done A deed of dreadful note.
passages.vernacular: 仲有安慰;佢哋係可以攻擊嘅。咁你就高興起嚟吧。喺蝙蝠完成佢寺院般嘅飛行之前,喺甲蟲應黑暗嘅赫卡忒嘅召喚、用昏沉嘅嗡嗡聲敲響夜嘅呵欠鐘聲之前,將會做成一件令人驚駭嘅事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 還有安慰;他們是可以攻擊的。那麼你就高興起來吧。在蝙蝠完成它寺院般的飛行之前,在甲蟲應黑暗的赫卡忒的召喚、用昏沉的嗡嗡聲敲響夜的呵欠鐘聲之前,將會做成一件令人驚駭的事。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: What’s to be done?
passages.vernacular: 要做乜嘢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要做什麼事?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Be innocent of the knowledge, dearest chuck, Till thou applaud the deed. Come, seeling night, Scarf up the tender eye of pitiful day, And with thy bloody and invisible hand Cancel and tear to pieces that great bond Which keeps me pale!—Light thickens; and the crow Makes wing to th’ rooky wood. Good things of day begin to droop and drowse, Whiles night’s black agents to their preys do rouse. Thou marvell’st at my words: but hold thee still; Things bad begun make strong themselves by ill. So, pr’ythee, go with me.
passages.vernacular: 最親愛嘅小寶貝,喺你為呢事飲彩之前,你唔使知道。嚟吧,縫合眼睛嘅夜,蒙上憐憫嘅白晝嗰溫柔嘅眼睛,用你血腥而無形嘅手,取消並撕碎嗰使我臉色蒼白嘅大契約!——光線變濃喇;烏鴉飛向鴉巢林。白天嘅美好事物開始垂頭昏瞓,而夜嘅黑色代理人醒嚟撲向佢哋嘅獵物。你對我嘅話感到驚訝:不過安靜下嚟;壞事開咗頭,要靠更壞嘅事使自己強大。所以,請你同我一起去。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最親愛的小寶貝,在你為這事喝彩之前,你不必知道。來吧,縫合眼睛的夜,蒙上憐憫的白晝那溫柔的眼睛,用你血腥而無形的手,取消並撕碎那使我臉色蒼白的大契約!——光線變濃了;烏鴉飛向鴉巢林。白天的美好事物開始垂頭昏睡,而夜的黑色代理人醒來撲向他們的獵物。你對我的話感到驚訝:不過安靜下來;壞事開了頭,要靠更壞的事使自己強大。所以,請你和我一起去。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene III — A Park near the Palace 第三幕第三場:王宮附近園地

passages.original: Enter three Murderers.
passages.vernacular: [三名刺客上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [三名刺客上。]

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: But who did bid thee join with us?
passages.vernacular: 不過邊個叫你加入我哋?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 可是誰叫你加入我們?

passages.title: Third Murderer 第三刺客
passages.original: Macbeth.
passages.vernacular: 馬克白。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 馬克白。

passages.title: Second Murderer 第二刺客
passages.original: He needs not our mistrust; since he delivers Our offices and what we have to do To the direction just.
passages.vernacular: 我哋唔使懷疑佢;因為佢把我哋嘅任務同我哋要做嘅事都準確地交代喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們不必懷疑他;因為他把我們的任務和我們要做的事都準確地交代了。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: Then stand with us. The west yet glimmers with some streaks of day. Now spurs the lated traveller apace, To gain the timely inn; and near approaches The subject of our watch.
passages.vernacular: 咁就站喺我哋呢邊。西邊仲透住啲日光嘅條紋。而家晚歸嘅旅人快馬加鞭,想及時趕到客店;而我哋守候嘅對象正在接近。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼就站在我們這邊。西邊還透著一些日光的條紋。現在晚歸的旅人快馬加鞭,想及時趕到客店;而我們守候的對象正在接近。

passages.title: Third Murderer 第三刺客
passages.original: Hark! I hear horses.
passages.vernacular: 聽!我聽到馬聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽!我聽到馬聲。

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: [Within.] Give us a light there, ho!
passages.vernacular: [內。]喂,畀我哋點個燈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內。]喂,給我們點個燈!

passages.title: Second Murderer 第二刺客
passages.original: Then ’tis he; the rest That are within the note of expectation Already are i’ th’ court.
passages.vernacular: 咁就係佢;其餘喺受邀名單上嘅人已經都喺宮裡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼就是他;其餘在受邀名單上的人已經都在宮裡。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: His horses go about.
passages.vernacular: 佢嘅馬被牽走喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他的馬被牽走了。

passages.title: Third Murderer 第三刺客
passages.original: Almost a mile; but he does usually, So all men do, from hence to the palace gate Make it their walk.
passages.vernacular: 差不多一英里;不過佢通常,像所有人嗰樣,從呢度到宮門係走路。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 差不多一英里;不過他通常,像所有人那樣,從這裡到宮門是走路。

passages.original: Enter Banquo and Fleance with a torch.
passages.vernacular: [班柯同弗里恩斯舉火把上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [班柯和弗里恩斯舉火把上。]

passages.title: Second Murderer 第二刺客
passages.original: A light, a light!
passages.vernacular: 一盞燈,一盞燈!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一盞燈,一盞燈!

passages.title: Third Murderer 第三刺客
passages.original: ’Tis he.
passages.vernacular: 係佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是他。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: Stand to’t.
passages.vernacular: 準備好。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 準備好。

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: It will be rain tonight.
passages.vernacular: 今晚要下雨。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 今晚要下雨。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: Let it come down.
passages.vernacular: 讓佢下吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 讓它下吧。

passages.original: [Assaults Banquo.]
passages.vernacular: [襲擊班柯。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [襲擊班柯。]

passages.title: Banquo 班柯
passages.original: O, treachery! Fly, good Fleance, fly, fly, fly! Thou mayst revenge—O slave!
passages.vernacular: 啊,背叛!逃,好弗里恩斯,逃,逃,逃!你可以報仇——啊,奴才!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,背叛!逃,好弗里恩斯,逃,逃,逃!你可以報仇——啊,奴才!

passages.original: [Dies. Fleance escapes.]
passages.vernacular: [死。弗里恩斯逃走。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [死。弗里恩斯逃走。]

passages.title: Third Murderer 第三刺客
passages.original: Who did strike out the light?
passages.vernacular: 邊個把燈打滅喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 誰把燈打滅了?

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: Was’t not the way?
passages.vernacular: 呢唔係辦法嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這不是辦法嗎?

passages.title: Third Murderer 第三刺客
passages.original: There’s but one down: the son is fled.
passages.vernacular: 只倒下一個:兒子逃喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只倒下一個:兒子逃了。

passages.title: Second Murderer 第二刺客
passages.original: We have lost best half of our affair.
passages.vernacular: 我哋失去咗呢事嘅大半。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們失去了這事的大半。

passages.title: First Murderer 第一刺客
passages.original: Well, let’s away, and say how much is done.
passages.vernacular: 好,走吧,去報告做成咗多少。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 好,走吧,去報告做成了多少。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene IV — A Room of State in the Palace 第三幕第四場:王宮宴會廳

passages.original: A banquet prepared. Enter Macbeth, Lady Macbeth, Ross, Lennox, Lords and Attendants.
passages.vernacular: [備好嘅宴席。馬克白、馬克白夫人、羅斯、倫諾克斯、群臣同侍從上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [備好的宴席。馬克白、馬克白夫人、羅斯、倫諾克斯、群臣和侍從上。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: You know your own degrees, sit down. At first And last the hearty welcome.
passages.vernacular: 你哋知道自己嘅位次,請坐。一開始同最後,都衷心歡迎。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們知道自己的位次,請坐。一開始和最後,都衷心歡迎。

passages.title: Lords 眾貴族
passages.original: Thanks to your Majesty.
passages.vernacular: 謝陛下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謝陛下。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Ourself will mingle with society, And play the humble host. Our hostess keeps her state; but, in best time, We will require her welcome.
passages.vernacular: 我自己將混喺賓客之中,扮演謙卑嘅主人。我哋嘅女主人保持佢嘅尊位;但喺適當嘅時候,我哋會請佢致歡迎詞。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我自己將混在賓客之中,扮演謙卑的主人。我們的女主人保持她的尊位;但在適當的時候,我們會請她致歡迎詞。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Pronounce it for me, sir, to all our friends; For my heart speaks they are welcome.
passages.vernacular: 先生,請替我向所有朋友宣布歡迎;因為我嘅心喺講佢哋係受歡迎嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 先生,請替我向所有朋友宣布歡迎;因為我的心在說他們是受歡迎的。

passages.original: Enter first Murderer to the door.
passages.vernacular: [第一名刺客走到門口。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [第一名刺客走到門口。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: See, they encounter thee with their hearts’ thanks. Both sides are even: here I’ll sit i’ th’ midst.
passages.vernacular: 睇,佢哋用心中嘅感謝嚟迎接你。兩邊相等:我就坐喺中間。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 看,他們用心中的感謝來迎接你。兩邊相等:我就坐在中間。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Be large in mirth; anon we’ll drink a measure The table round. There’s blood upon thy face.
passages.vernacular: 盡情歡樂;等一下我哋繞桌子乾一輪酒。你臉上有血。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 盡情歡樂;等一下我們繞桌子乾一輪酒。你臉上有血。

passages.title: Murderer 刺客
passages.original: ’Tis Banquo’s then.
passages.vernacular: 咁係班柯嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼是班柯的。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: ’Tis better thee without than he within. Is he dispatch’d?
passages.vernacular: 喺你外面比喺佢裡面好。佢解決咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在你外面比在他裡面好。他解決了嗎?

passages.title: Murderer 刺客
passages.original: My lord, his throat is cut. That I did for him.
passages.vernacular: 陛下,佢嘅喉嚨割斷喇。嗰個係我替佢做嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,他的喉嚨割斷了。那是我替他做的。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Thou art the best o’ th’ cut-throats; Yet he’s good that did the like for Fleance: If thou didst it, thou art the nonpareil.
passages.vernacular: 你係最好嘅割喉手;不過替弗里恩斯做同樣事嘅人都不錯:如果係你做嘅,你就係無同倫比。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你是最好的割喉手;不過替弗里恩斯做同樣事的人也不錯:如果是你做的,你就是無與倫比。

passages.title: Murderer 刺客
passages.original: Most royal sir, Fleance is ’scap’d.
passages.vernacular: 最尊貴嘅陛下,弗里恩斯逃走喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 最尊貴的陛下,弗里恩斯逃走了。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Then comes my fit again: I had else been perfect; Whole as the marble, founded as the rock, As broad and general as the casing air: But now I am cabin’d, cribb’d, confin’d, bound in To saucy doubts and fears. But Banquo’s safe?
passages.vernacular: 嗰我嘅病又發作喇:否則我本可完美;完整如大理石,穩固如岩石,廣闊自由如包圍嘅空氣:但而家我被關喺斗室、被圈住、被囚禁、被縛喺放肆嘅疑慮同恐懼之中。但班柯安全咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那我的病又發作了:否則我本可完美;完整如大理石,穩固如岩石,廣闊自由如包圍的空氣:但現在我被關在斗室、被圈住、被囚禁、被縛在放肆的疑慮和恐懼之中。但班柯安全了嗎?

passages.title: Murderer 刺客
passages.original: Ay, my good lord. Safe in a ditch he bides, With twenty trenched gashes on his head; The least a death to nature.
passages.vernacular: 係,我嘅好陛下。佢安全地躺喺溝裡,頭上有二十道深深嘅傷口;最小嘅一道都足以致自然人於死。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,我的好陛下。他安全地躺在溝裡,頭上有二十道深深的傷口;最小的一道也足以致自然人於死。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Thanks for that. There the grown serpent lies; the worm that’s fled Hath nature that in time will venom breed, No teeth for th’ present.—Get thee gone; tomorrow We’ll hear, ourselves, again.
passages.vernacular: 謝謝你。嗰度躺住成年嘅蛇;逃走嘅小蟲,天性中有日後會生出毒液嘅嘢,而家仲冇牙齒。——你走吧;聽日我哋再親自聽你講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 謝謝你。那裡躺著成年的蛇;逃走的小蟲,天性中有日後會生出毒液的東西,現在還沒有牙齒。——你走吧;明天我們再親自聽你說。

passages.original: [Exit Murderer.]
passages.vernacular: [刺客下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [刺客下。]

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: My royal lord, You do not give the cheer: the feast is sold That is not often vouch’d, while ’tis a-making, ’Tis given with welcome. To feed were best at home; From thence the sauce to meat is ceremony; Meeting were bare without it.
passages.vernacular: 我嘅君王陛下,你冇盡到款待之道:宴席若喺進行中不時時表明係帶住歡迎獻上嘅,就等於是賣嘅。單係食飯,喺家裡最好;出咗家門,肉嘅調味就係禮數;冇佢,聚會就太寒酸喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我的君王陛下,你沒有盡到款待之道:宴席若在進行中不時時表明是帶著歡迎獻上的,就等於是賣的。單是吃飯,在家裡最好;出了家門,肉的調味就是禮數;沒有它,聚會就太寒酸了。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: The Ghost of Banquo rises, and sits in Macbeth’s place.
passages.vernacular: [班柯嘅鬼魂上,坐喺馬克白嘅位子上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [班柯的鬼魂上,坐在馬克白的位子上。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Sweet remembrancer!— Now, good digestion wait on appetite, And health on both!
passages.vernacular: 甜蜜嘅提醒者!——而家,願好消化伴住胃口,健康伴住兩者!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 甜蜜的提醒者!——現在,願好消化伴著胃口,健康伴著兩者!

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: May’t please your Highness sit.
passages.vernacular: 請陛下就座。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請陛下就座。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Here had we now our country’s honour roof’d, Were the grac’d person of our Banquo present; Who may I rather challenge for unkindness Than pity for mischance!
passages.vernacular: 要係我哋可敬嘅班柯在場,我哋全國嘅榮譽此刻就都聚喺呢屋簷下喇;我寧可責備佢無情,都唔願可憐佢遭遇不幸!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要是我們可敬的班柯在場,我們全國的榮譽此刻就都聚在這屋簷下了;我寧可責備他無情,也不願可憐他遭遇不幸!

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: His absence, sir, Lays blame upon his promise. Please’t your Highness To grace us with your royal company?
passages.vernacular: 陛下,佢嘅缺席使佢違背咗承諾。請陛下賞光,同我哋同坐好嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,他的缺席使他違背了承諾。請陛下賞光,與我們同坐好嗎?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: The table’s full.
passages.vernacular: 桌子滿喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 桌子滿了。

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: Here is a place reserv’d, sir.
passages.vernacular: 呢度有個留好嘅位子,先生。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡有個留好的位子,先生。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Where?
passages.vernacular: 邊度?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哪裡?

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: Here, my good lord. What is’t that moves your Highness?
passages.vernacular: 呢度,我嘅好陛下。係乜嘢讓陛下激動?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這裡,我的好陛下。是什麼讓陛下激動?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Which of you have done this?
passages.vernacular: 你哋邊一個幹咗呢事?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你們哪一個幹了這事?

passages.title: Lords 眾貴族
passages.original: What, my good lord?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,我嘅好陛下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,我的好陛下?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Thou canst not say I did it. Never shake Thy gory locks at me.
passages.vernacular: 你唔能夠講係我幹嘅。別對我搖動你染血嘅頭髮。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不能說是我幹的。別對我搖動你染血的頭髮。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: Gentlemen, rise; his Highness is not well.
passages.vernacular: 諸位,起嚟;陛下不舒服。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 諸位,起來;陛下不舒服。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Sit, worthy friends. My lord is often thus, And hath been from his youth: pray you, keep seat; The fit is momentary; upon a thought He will again be well. If much you note him, You shall offend him, and extend his passion. Feed, and regard him not.—Are you a man?
passages.vernacular: 請坐,尊貴嘅朋友哋。我嘅陛下常咁樣,從年輕時就咁樣:請你哋保持就座;呢病係一時嘅;轉眼間佢就會再好。如果你哋太注意佢,會冒犯佢,並加劇佢嘅發作。食吧,別理佢。——你係男人嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請坐,尊貴的朋友們。我的陛下常這樣,從年輕時就這樣:請你們保持就座;這病是一時的;轉眼間他就會再好。如果你們太注意他,會冒犯他,並加劇他的發作。吃吧,別理他。——你是男人嗎?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Ay, and a bold one, that dare look on that Which might appal the devil.
passages.vernacular: 係,而且係個大膽嘅男人,敢睇嗰連魔鬼都會嚇壞嘅嘢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,而且是個大膽的男人,敢看那連魔鬼也會嚇壞的東西。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: O proper stuff! This is the very painting of your fear: This is the air-drawn dagger which you said, Led you to Duncan. O, these flaws, and starts (Impostors to true fear), would well become A woman’s story at a winter’s fire, Authoris’d by her grandam. Shame itself! Why do you make such faces? When all’s done, You look but on a stool.
passages.vernacular: 啊,真好嘅嘢!呢正是你恐懼嘅畫像:呢個就係你講過領你去見鄧肯嘅空氣中畫出嘅匕首。啊,呢啲陣風同驚跳(真正恐懼嘅冒牌貨),好適合冬天爐火旁、由祖母認可嘅女人故事。真丟臉!你點解做呢啲鬼臉?講到底,你睇嘅只係一張凳子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,真好的東西!這正是你恐懼的畫像:這就是你說過領你去見鄧肯的空氣中畫出的匕首。啊,這些陣風和驚跳(真正恐懼的冒牌貨),很適合冬天爐火旁、由祖母認可的女人故事。真丟臉!你為什麼做這些鬼臉?說到底,你看的只是一張凳子。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Pr’ythee, see there! Behold! look! lo! how say you? Why, what care I? If thou canst nod, speak too.— If charnel houses and our graves must send Those that we bury back, our monuments Shall be the maws of kites.
passages.vernacular: 請你睇嗰度!睇!瞧!睇邊!你點講?哎,我在乎乜嘢?如果你能點頭,都講話吧。——如果停屍間同墳墓必須把我哋埋葬嘅人送回嚟,嗰我哋嘅墳墓就將係鳶嘅肚子。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你看那裡!看!瞧!看哪!你怎麼說?哎,我在乎什麼?如果你能點頭,也說話吧。——如果停屍間和墳墓必須把我們埋葬的人送回來,那我們的墳墓就將是鳶的肚子。

passages.original: [Ghost disappears.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂消失。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂消失。]

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: What, quite unmann’d in folly?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢,喺愚蠢中完全失去男子氣概?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼,在愚蠢中完全失去男子氣概?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: If I stand here, I saw him.
passages.vernacular: 只要我站喺呢度,我睇見咗佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 只要我站在這裡,我看見了他。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Fie, for shame!
passages.vernacular: 呸,羞恥!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 呸,羞恥!

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Blood hath been shed ere now, i’ th’ olden time, Ere humane statute purg’d the gentle weal; Ay, and since too, murders have been perform’d Too terrible for the ear: the time has been, That, when the brains were out, the man would die, And there an end; but now they rise again, With twenty mortal murders on their crowns, And push us from our stools. This is more strange Than such a murder is.
passages.vernacular: 喺古時候,喺人道嘅法律淨化溫和嘅國家之前,血已經流過;對,後來都有謀殺做得太可怕,不堪入耳:從前嘅情形係,腦漿流出,人就死喇,事情就完;但而家佢哋又起嚟,頭上帶住二十處致命嘅傷,把我哋從凳子上推下去。呢比嗰樣嘅謀殺更奇怪。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 在古時候,在人道的法律淨化溫和的國家之前,血已經流過;對,後來也有謀殺做得太可怕,不堪入耳:從前的情形是,腦漿流出,人就死了,事情就完;但現在他們又起來,頭上帶著二十處致命的傷,把我們從凳子上推下去。這比那樣的謀殺更奇怪。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: My worthy lord, Your noble friends do lack you.
passages.vernacular: 我尊貴嘅陛下,你高貴嘅朋友哋需要你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我尊貴的陛下,你高貴的朋友們需要你。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: I do forget.— Do not muse at me, my most worthy friends. I have a strange infirmity, which is nothing To those that know me. Come, love and health to all; Then I’ll sit down.—Give me some wine, fill full.— I drink to the general joy o’ th’ whole table, And to our dear friend Banquo, whom we miss: Would he were here.
passages.vernacular: 我忘喇。——別對我感到疑惑,我最尊貴嘅朋友哋。我有種奇怪嘅毛病,對認識我嘅人來講算不咗乜嘢。嚟,愛同健康敬各位;然後我坐下。——畀我倒酒,斟滿。——我為全桌嘅歡樂乾杯,都為我哋想念嘅親愛朋友班柯:願佢喺呢度。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我忘了。——別對我感到疑惑,我最尊貴的朋友們。我有種奇怪的毛病,對認識我的人來說算不了什麼。來,愛與健康敬各位;然後我坐下。——給我倒酒,斟滿。——我為全桌的歡樂乾杯,也為我們想念的親愛朋友班柯:願他在這裡。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Ghost rises again.
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂再次升起。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂再次升起。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: To all, and him, we thirst, And all to all.
passages.vernacular: 敬所有人,同佢,我哋渴望地乾杯,所有人敬所有人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 敬所有人,和他,我們渴望地乾杯,所有人敬所有人。

passages.title: Lords 眾貴族
passages.original: Our duties, and the pledge.
passages.vernacular: 我哋嘅敬意,同乾杯。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們的敬意,和乾杯。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Avaunt! and quit my sight! let the earth hide thee! Thy bones are marrowless, thy blood is cold; Thou hast no speculation in those eyes Which thou dost glare with!
passages.vernacular: 走開!離開我嘅視線!讓大地把你藏起嚟!你嘅骨頭冇骨髓,你嘅血係冷嘅;你瞪住我嘅嗰雙眼睛毫無視力!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 走開!離開我的視線!讓大地把你藏起來!你的骨頭沒有骨髓,你的血是冷的;你瞪著我的那雙眼睛毫無視力!

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Think of this, good peers, But as a thing of custom: ’tis no other, Only it spoils the pleasure of the time.
passages.vernacular: 各位貴族,請把呢當作尋常嘅事:不過係咁樣,只係佢掃咗呢陣刻嘅興致。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 各位貴族,請把這當作尋常的事:不過是這樣,只是它掃了這時刻的興致。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: What man dare, I dare: Approach thou like the rugged Russian bear, The arm’d rhinoceros, or th’ Hyrcan tiger; Take any shape but that, and my firm nerves Shall never tremble: or be alive again, And dare me to the desert with thy sword; If trembling I inhabit then, protest me The baby of a girl. Hence, horrible shadow! Unreal mock’ry, hence!
passages.vernacular: 凡是人敢做嘅,我都敢:你就像粗暴嘅俄羅斯熊、披甲犀牛、或海爾卡尼亞嘅老虎一樣走近;取任何形狀,只要唔係呢個,我堅定嘅神經就唔會顫抖:或者你再活過嚟,攞住劍邀我到荒野決鬥;如果嗰時我顫抖住待喺家裡,就宣布我係個小女孩嘅娃娃。滾開,可怕嘅影子!虛幻嘅嘲弄,滾開!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 凡是人敢做的,我都敢:你就像粗暴的俄羅斯熊、披甲犀牛、或海爾卡尼亞的老虎一樣走近;取任何形狀,只要不是這個,我堅定的神經就不會顫抖:或者你再活過來,拿著劍邀我到荒野決鬥;如果那時我顫抖著待在家裡,就宣布我是個小女孩的娃娃。滾開,可怕的影子!虛幻的嘲弄,滾開!

passages.original: [Ghost disappears.]
passages.vernacular: [鬼魂消失。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [鬼魂消失。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Why, so;—being gone, I am a man again.—Pray you, sit still.
passages.vernacular: 哎,對喇;——佢走喇,我又係個男人喇。——請你哋繼續坐住。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哎,對了;——它走了,我又是個男人了。——請你們繼續坐著。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: You have displaced the mirth, broke the good meeting With most admir’d disorder.
passages.vernacular: 你打亂咗歡樂,用最驚人嘅混亂破壞咗美好嘅聚會。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你打亂了歡樂,用最驚人的混亂破壞了美好的聚會。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Can such things be, And overcome us like a summer’s cloud, Without our special wonder? You make me strange Even to the disposition that I owe, When now I think you can behold such sights, And keep the natural ruby of your cheeks, When mine are blanch’d with fear.
passages.vernacular: 咁樣嘅事會有,像夏天嘅雲一樣壓倒我哋,而我哋卻不覺得特別驚奇嗎?你讓我連對自己嘅本性都感到陌生,因為而家我想你哋能睇到咁樣嘅景象,臉頰仍保有天然嘅紅潤,而我嘅已被恐懼嚇白。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這樣的事會有,像夏天的雲一樣壓倒我們,而我們卻不覺得特別驚奇嗎?你讓我連對自己的本性都感到陌生,因為現在我想你們能看到這樣的景象,臉頰仍保有天然的紅潤,而我的已被恐懼嚇白。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: What sights, my lord?
passages.vernacular: 乜嘢景象,陛下?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 什麼景象,陛下?

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: I pray you, speak not; he grows worse and worse; Question enrages him. At once, good night:— Stand not upon the order of your going, But go at once.
passages.vernacular: 請你唔好講話;佢越嚟越糟;一問就激怒佢。大家即刻告辭,晚安:唔使拘泥離開嘅次序,即刻走。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 請你別說話;他越來越糟;一問就激怒他。大家立刻告辭,晚安:不必拘泥離開的次序,馬上走。

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: Good night; and better health Attend his Majesty!
passages.vernacular: 晚安;願更好嘅健康陪伴陛下!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 晚安;願更好的健康陪伴陛下!

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: A kind good night to all!
passages.vernacular: 畀所有人一個親切嘅晚安!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 給所有人一個親切的晚安!

passages.original: [Exeunt all Lords and Attendants.]
passages.vernacular: [群臣同侍從全部下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [群臣與侍從全部下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: It will have blood, they say, blood will have blood. Stones have been known to move, and trees to speak; Augurs, and understood relations, have By magot-pies, and choughs, and rooks, brought forth The secret’st man of blood.—What is the night?
passages.vernacular: 佢哋講,血要報,血要償血。石頭曾被知道會移動,樹會講話;占卜者同人所理解嘅關聯,通過喜鵲、寒鴉同烏鴉,揭露咗最隱秘嘅殺人者。——夜到乜嘢時候喇?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他們說,血要報,血要償血。石頭曾被知道會移動,樹會說話;占卜者和人所理解的關聯,通過喜鵲、寒鴉和烏鴉,揭露了最隱秘的殺人者。——夜到什麼時候了?

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Almost at odds with morning, which is which.
passages.vernacular: 快要同早晨爭奪,分不清係邊個。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 快要和早晨爭奪,分不清是哪個。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: How say’st thou, that Macduff denies his person At our great bidding?
passages.vernacular: 你講麥克德夫拒絕喺我哋鄭重召喚時到場,你點講?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你說麥克德夫拒絕在我們鄭重召喚時到場,你怎麼說?

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: Did you send to him, sir?
passages.vernacular: 陛下,您派人去叫佢咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下,您派人去叫他了嗎?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: I hear it by the way; but I will send. There’s not a one of them but in his house I keep a servant fee’d. I will tomorrow (And betimes I will) to the Weird Sisters: More shall they speak; for now I am bent to know, By the worst means, the worst. For mine own good, All causes shall give way: I am in blood Stepp’d in so far that, should I wade no more, Returning were as tedious as go o’er. Strange things I have in head, that will to hand, Which must be acted ere they may be scann’d.
passages.vernacular: 我係順便聽講嘅;但我會派人去。佢哋每一個人家裡,我都養住一個收咗錢嘅僕人。聽日(而且係一早)我要去找嗰啲女巫姊妹:佢哋仲要多講;因為而家我決心知道,用最壞嘅手段,知道最壞嘅事。為了我自己嘅利益,一切理由都得讓路:我已喺血中踏得咁深,即使唔再涉水前進,回頭都同渡過去一樣乏味。我腦子裡有奇怪嘅事,將要動手,必須先行動,才能被審視。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我是順便聽說的;但我會派人去。他們每一個人家裡,我都養著一個收了錢的僕人。明天(而且是一早)我要去找那些女巫姊妹:她們還要多說;因為現在我決心知道,用最壞的手段,知道最壞的事。為了我自己的利益,一切理由都得讓路:我已在血中踏得這麼深,即使不再涉水前進,回頭也和渡過去一樣乏味。我腦子裡有奇怪的事,將要動手,必須先行動,才能被審視。

passages.title: Lady Macbeth 馬克白夫人
passages.original: You lack the season of all natures, sleep.
passages.vernacular: 你缺少一切生物嘅調劑——瞓眠。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你缺少一切生物的調劑——睡眠。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Come, we’ll to sleep. My strange and self-abuse Is the initiate fear that wants hard use. We are yet but young in deed.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,我哋去瞓吧。我呢奇怪嘅自我欺騙,係缺少磨練嘅初發恐懼。我哋喺行動上仲只係新手。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,我們去睡吧。我這奇怪的自我欺騙,是缺少磨練的初發恐懼。我們在行動上還只是新手。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene V — The Heath 第三幕第五場:荒野

passages.original: Thunder. Enter the three Witches meeting Hecate.
passages.vernacular: [雷聲。三女巫遇見赫卡忒。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雷聲。三女巫遇見赫卡忒。]

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Why, how now, Hecate? you look angerly.
passages.vernacular: 點喇,赫卡忒?你睇起嚟喺發怒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼了,赫卡忒?你看起來在發怒。

passages.title: Hecate 赫卡忒
passages.original: Have I not reason, beldams as you are, Saucy and overbold? How did you dare To trade and traffic with Macbeth In riddles and affairs of death; And I, the mistress of your charms, The close contriver of all harms, Was never call’d to bear my part, Or show the glory of our art? And, which is worse, all you have done Hath been but for a wayward son, Spiteful and wrathful; who, as others do, Loves for his own ends, not for you. But make amends now: get you gone, And at the pit of Acheron Meet me i’ th’ morning: thither he Will come to know his destiny. Your vessels and your spells provide, Your charms, and everything beside. I am for th’ air; this night I’ll spend Unto a dismal and a fatal end. Great business must be wrought ere noon. Upon the corner of the moon There hangs a vap’rous drop profound; I’ll catch it ere it come to ground: And that, distill’d by magic sleights, Shall raise such artificial sprites, As, by the strength of their illusion, Shall draw him on to his confusion. He shall spurn fate, scorn death, and bear His hopes ’bove wisdom, grace, and fear. And you all know, security Is mortals’ chiefest enemy.
passages.vernacular: 我難道冇理由嗎,你哋呢啲老妖婆,放肆又過分大膽?你哋點敢用謎語同死亡之事去同馬克白做買賣交易;而我,你哋法術嘅女主人,一切禍害嘅暗中策劃者,卻從冇被叫去盡我嘅一份,或展示我哋法術嘅榮耀?更糟嘅係,你哋所做嘅一切,只係為了一個任性嘅兒子,惡毒而暴怒;佢像別人一樣,愛嘅係自己嘅目的,唔係你哋。而家嚟補過:你哋走吧,明早喺阿刻戎嘅深坑同我會合:佢會到嗰度去知道佢嘅命運。備好你哋嘅器皿同咒語,你哋嘅法術,同其他一切。我要上天;今晚我將度過,走向一個淒慘而致命嘅結局。正午之前必須成就大事。月亮嘅角上懸住一滴深邃嘅霧氣;我要喺佢落地前接住:用魔法嘅手法蒸餾佢,將升起咁樣人造嘅精靈,憑佢哋幻象嘅力量,把佢引向毀滅。佢將蔑視命運,嘲笑死亡,把希望懸喺智慧、恩典同恐懼之上。你哋都知道,安全感係凡人最大嘅敵人。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我難道沒有理由嗎,你們這些老妖婆,放肆又過分大膽?你們怎麼敢用謎語和死亡之事去和馬克白做買賣交易;而我,你們法術的女主人,一切禍害的暗中策劃者,卻從沒被叫去盡我的一份,或展示我們法術的榮耀?更糟的是,你們所做的一切,只是為了一個任性的兒子,惡毒而暴怒;他像別人一樣,愛的是自己的目的,不是你們。現在來補過:你們走吧,明早在阿刻戎的深坑與我會合:他會到那裡去知道他的命運。備好你們的器皿和咒語,你們的法術,和其他一切。我要上天;今晚我將度過,走向一個淒慘而致命的結局。正午之前必須成就大事。月亮的角上懸著一滴深邃的霧氣;我要在它落地前接住:用魔法的手法蒸餾它,將升起這樣人造的精靈,憑它們幻象的力量,把他引向毀滅。他將蔑視命運,嘲笑死亡,把希望懸在智慧、恩典與恐懼之上。你們都知道,安全感是凡人最大的敵人。

passages.original: [Music and song within, “Come away, come away” &c.]
passages.vernacular: [內有音樂同歌聲:「嚟吧,嚟吧」等。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有音樂和歌聲:「來吧,來吧」等。]

passages.title: Hecate 赫卡忒
passages.original: Hark! I am call’d; my little spirit, see, Sits in a foggy cloud and stays for me.
passages.vernacular: 聽!我被叫喇;睇,我嘅小精靈坐喺霧濛濛嘅雲裡等我。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽!我被叫了;看,我的小精靈坐在霧濛濛的雲裡等我。

passages.original: [Exit.]

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Come, let’s make haste; she’ll soon be back again.
passages.vernacular: 嚟,我哋快點;佢好快就回嚟喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來,我們快點;她很快就回來了。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act III, Scene VI — Forres. A Room in the Palace 第三幕第六場:福里斯王宮一室

passages.original: Enter Lennox and another Lord.
passages.vernacular: [倫諾克斯同另一位貴族上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [倫諾克斯和另一位貴族上。]

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: My former speeches have but hit your thoughts, Which can interpret farther: only, I say, Thing’s have been strangely borne. The gracious Duncan Was pitied of Macbeth:—marry, he was dead:— And the right valiant Banquo walk’d too late; Whom, you may say, if’t please you, Fleance kill’d, For Fleance fled. Men must not walk too late. Who cannot want the thought, how monstrous It was for Malcolm and for Donalbain To kill their gracious father? damned fact! How it did grieve Macbeth! did he not straight, In pious rage, the two delinquents tear That were the slaves of drink and thralls of sleep? Was not that nobly done? Ay, and wisely too; For ’twould have anger’d any heart alive, To hear the men deny’t. So that, I say, He has borne all things well: and I do think, That had he Duncan’s sons under his key (As, and’t please heaven, he shall not) they should find What ’twere to kill a father; so should Fleance. But, peace!—for from broad words, and ’cause he fail’d His presence at the tyrant’s feast, I hear, Macduff lives in disgrace. Sir, can you tell Where he bestows himself?
passages.vernacular: 我先前嘅話只係觸及你嘅想法,你可以進一步解讀:我只講,事情被處理得好奇怪。仁慈嘅鄧肯被馬克白哀憐:——哎,係喺佢死咗之後:——而英勇嘅班柯走得太晚;你若願意可以講,係弗里恩斯殺咗佢,因為弗里恩斯逃喇。人不可走得太晚。邊個能唔想到,馬爾康同唐納本殺死佢哋仁慈嘅父親係幾咁駭人?該死嘅行為!馬克白幾咁悲痛!佢唔係即刻喺虔誠嘅憤怒中,撕碎咗嗰兩個酒嘅奴隸、瞓眠嘅俘虜嗎?嗰唔係高貴地做咗嗎?對,而且都好明智;因為聽到嗰啲人否認,會激怒任何活人嘅心。所以,我講,佢把一切都處理得好好:而且我認為,要係佢把鄧肯嘅兒子哋關喺佢嘅鑰匙下(但願上天不讓佢如此),佢哋會知道殺父係乜嘢滋味;弗里恩斯都一樣。不過,噓!——因為口出狂言,又因為冇出席暴君嘅宴會,我聽講,麥克德夫失寵喇。先生,你能告訴我佢而家喺邊度嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我先前的話只是觸及你的想法,你可以進一步解讀:我只說,事情被處理得很奇怪。仁慈的鄧肯被馬克白哀憐:——哎,是在他死了之後:——而英勇的班柯走得太晚;你若願意可以說,是弗里恩斯殺了他,因為弗里恩斯逃了。人不可走得太晚。誰能不想到,馬爾康和唐納本殺死他們仁慈的父親是多麼駭人?該死的行為!馬克白多麼悲痛!他不是立刻在虔誠的憤怒中,撕碎了那兩個酒的奴隸、睡眠的俘虜嗎?那不是高貴地做了嗎?對,而且也很明智;因為聽到那些人否認,會激怒任何活人的心。所以,我說,他把一切都處理得很好:而且我認為,要是他把鄧肯的兒子們關在他的鑰匙下(但願上天不讓他如此),他們會知道殺父是什麼滋味;弗里恩斯也一樣。不過,噓!——因為口出狂言,又因為沒有出席暴君的宴會,我聽說,麥克德夫失寵了。先生,你能告訴我他現在在哪裡嗎?

passages.title: Lord 貴族
passages.original: The son of Duncan, From whom this tyrant holds the due of birth, Lives in the English court and is receiv’d Of the most pious Edward with such grace That the malevolence of fortune nothing Takes from his high respect. Thither Macduff Is gone to pray the holy king, upon his aid To wake Northumberland, and warlike Siward That, by the help of these (with Him above To ratify the work), we may again Give to our tables meat, sleep to our nights; Free from our feasts and banquets bloody knives, Do faithful homage, and receive free honours, All which we pine for now. And this report Hath so exasperate the King that he Prepares for some attempt of war.
passages.vernacular: 鄧肯嘅兒子,被呢暴君奪去咗生來嘅權利,住喺英格蘭宮廷,受到最虔誠嘅愛德華嗰樣嘅恩待,以致命運嘅惡意絲毫無損佢嘅崇高尊重。麥克德夫已去嗰度,懇求聖王助佢一臂之力,喚起諾森伯蘭同好戰嘅西華德,靠呢啲人嘅幫助(有上面嗰位嚟批准呢事業),我哋可以再次讓餐桌有肉,讓夜晚有瞓眠;讓我哋嘅宴會免於血刀,恭敬地獻上忠誠,並獲得自由嘅榮譽,呢一切我哋而家都渴望不已。呢消息使國王好惱怒,佢正準備某種戰爭行動。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 鄧肯的兒子,被這暴君奪去了生來的權利,住在英格蘭宮廷,受到最虔誠的愛德華那樣的恩待,以致命運的惡意絲毫無損他的崇高尊重。麥克德夫已去那裡,懇求聖王助他一臂之力,喚起諾森伯蘭和好戰的西華德,靠這些人的幫助(有上面那位來批准這事業),我們可以再次讓餐桌有肉,讓夜晚有睡眠;讓我們的宴會免於血刀,恭敬地獻上忠誠,並獲得自由的榮譽,這一切我們現在都渴望不已。這消息使國王十分惱怒,他正準備某種戰爭行動。

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: Sent he to Macduff?
passages.vernacular: 佢派人去找過麥克德夫嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他派人去找過麥克德夫嗎?

passages.title: Lord 貴族
passages.original: He did: and with an absolute “Sir, not I,” The cloudy messenger turns me his back, And hums, as who should say, “You’ll rue the time That clogs me with this answer.”
passages.vernacular: 派喇:得到一句乾脆嘅「先生,我不去」,嗰陰沉嘅信使就轉身背向我,哼住,好像喺講「你會後悔畀我咁樣嘅回答嘅時候」。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 派了:得到一句乾脆的「先生,我不去」,那陰沉的信使就轉身背向我,哼著,好像在說「你會後悔給我這樣的回答的時候」。

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: And that well might Advise him to a caution, t’ hold what distance His wisdom can provide. Some holy angel Fly to the court of England, and unfold His message ere he come, that a swift blessing May soon return to this our suffering country Under a hand accurs’d!
passages.vernacular: 呢個好可能使佢警惕,同佢嘅智慧所能提供嘅保持距離。願邊位聖天使飛往英格蘭宮廷,喺佢到達之前轉達佢嘅消息,使迅速嘅福佑早日回到我哋呢飽受苦難、喺被詛咒之手下嘅國家!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這很可能使他警惕,與他的智慧所能提供的保持距離。願哪位聖天使飛往英格蘭宮廷,在他到達之前轉達他的消息,使迅速的福佑早日回到我們這飽受苦難、在被詛咒之手下的國家!

passages.title: Lord 貴族
passages.original: I’ll send my prayers with him.
passages.vernacular: 我願同佢同送我嘅祈禱。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我願與他同送我的祈禱。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene I — A Dark Cave 第四幕第一場:黑暗山洞

passages.original: Thunder. Enter the three Witches.
passages.vernacular: [雷聲。三女巫上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雷聲。三女巫上。]

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Thrice the brinded cat hath mew’d.
passages.vernacular: 虎斑貓已叫咗三聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 虎斑貓已叫了三聲。

passages.title: Second Witch 第二女巫
passages.original: Thrice, and once the hedge-pig whin’d.
passages.vernacular: 三聲,刺蝟又嗚咽咗一聲。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 三聲,刺蝟又嗚咽了一聲。

passages.title: Third Witch 第三女巫
passages.original: Harpier cries:—’Tis time, ’tis time.
passages.vernacular: 哈比叫道:——時候到喇,時候到喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 哈比叫道:——時候到了,時候到了。

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Round about the cauldron go; In the poison’d entrails throw.— Toad, that under cold stone Days and nights has thirty-one Swelter’d venom sleeping got, Boil thou first i’ th’ charmed pot!
passages.vernacular: 繞住大鍋走,把有毒嘅內臟扔進去。——癩蛤蟆,你喺冷石頭下三十一天三十一夜,瞓住時出汗釀成毒液,你先喺魔法鍋裡煮!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 繞著大鍋走,把有毒的內臟扔進去。——癩蛤蟆,你在冷石頭下三十一天三十一夜,睡著時出汗釀成毒液,你先在魔法鍋裡煮!

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Double, double, toil and trouble; Fire, burn; and cauldron, bubble.
passages.vernacular: 加倍,加倍,辛勞同麻煩;火,燒;鍋,冒泡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 加倍,加倍,辛勞與麻煩;火,燒;鍋,冒泡。

passages.title: Second Witch 第二女巫
passages.original: Fillet of a fenny snake, In the cauldron boil and bake; Eye of newt, and toe of frog, Wool of bat, and tongue of dog, Adder’s fork, and blind-worm’s sting, Lizard’s leg, and howlet’s wing, For a charm of powerful trouble, Like a hell-broth boil and bubble.
passages.vernacular: 沼澤蛇嘅肉片,喺鍋裡煮啊烤;蠑螈嘅眼,青蛙嘅趾,蝙蝠嘅毛,狗嘅舌,蝮蛇嘅叉,盲蛇嘅刺,蜥蜴嘅腿,小貓頭鷹嘅翅,作成強力麻煩嘅咒語,像地獄嘅濃湯一樣煮啊冒泡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沼澤蛇的肉片,在鍋裡煮啊烤;蠑螈的眼,青蛙的趾,蝙蝠的毛,狗的舌,蝮蛇的叉,盲蛇的刺,蜥蜴的腿,小貓頭鷹的翅,作成強力麻煩的咒語,像地獄的濃湯一樣煮啊冒泡。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Double, double, toil and trouble; Fire, burn; and cauldron, bubble.
passages.vernacular: 加倍,加倍,辛勞同麻煩;火,燒;鍋,冒泡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 加倍,加倍,辛勞與麻煩;火,燒;鍋,冒泡。

passages.title: Third Witch 第三女巫
passages.original: Scale of dragon, tooth of wolf, Witch’s mummy, maw and gulf Of the ravin’d salt-sea shark, Root of hemlock digg’d i’ th’ dark, Liver of blaspheming Jew, Gall of goat, and slips of yew Sliver’d in the moon’s eclipse, Nose of Turk, and Tartar’s lips, Finger of birth-strangled babe Ditch-deliver’d by a drab, Make the gruel thick and slab: Add thereto a tiger’s chaudron, For th’ ingredients of our cauldron.
passages.vernacular: 龍鱗,狼牙,女巫嘅木乃伊,貪食嘅鹹水鯊魚嘅胃同喉,黑暗中挖嘅毒芹根,褻瀆神明嘅猶太人嘅肝,山羊嘅膽,月蝕時削下嘅紫杉枝,土耳其人嘅鼻,韃靼人嘅唇,妓女喺溝裡生下、出生時被掐死嘅嬰兒嘅手指,讓呢粥變濃變稠:再加上一副老虎嘅內臟,作為我哋鍋裡嘅配料。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 龍鱗,狼牙,女巫的木乃伊,貪食的鹹水鯊魚的胃和喉,黑暗中挖的毒芹根,褻瀆神明的猶太人的肝,山羊的膽,月蝕時削下的紫杉枝,土耳其人的鼻,韃靼人的唇,妓女在溝裡生下、出生時被掐死的嬰兒的手指,讓這粥變濃變稠:再加上一副老虎的內臟,作為我們鍋裡的配料。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Double, double, toil and trouble; Fire, burn; and cauldron, bubble.
passages.vernacular: 加倍,加倍,辛勞同麻煩;火,燒;鍋,冒泡。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 加倍,加倍,辛勞與麻煩;火,燒;鍋,冒泡。

passages.title: Second Witch 第二女巫
passages.original: Cool it with a baboon’s blood. Then the charm is firm and good.
passages.vernacular: 用狒狒嘅血把佢冷卻。咁咒語就牢固而好喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 用狒狒的血把它冷卻。那麼咒語就牢固而好了。

passages.original: Enter Hecate.
passages.vernacular: [赫卡忒上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [赫卡忒上。]

passages.title: Hecate 赫卡忒
passages.original: O, well done! I commend your pains, And everyone shall share i’ th’ gains. And now about the cauldron sing, Like elves and fairies in a ring, Enchanting all that you put in.
passages.vernacular: 啊,做得好!我讚賞你哋嘅辛勞,每個人都分享所得。而家繞住鍋唱歌,像精靈同仙子圍成圈,迷惑你哋放進去嘅一切。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 啊,做得好!我讚賞你們的辛勞,每個人都分享所得。現在繞著鍋唱歌,像精靈和仙子圍成圈,迷惑你們放進去的一切。

passages.original: [Music and a song: “Black Spirits,” &c.]
passages.vernacular: [內有音樂同歌聲:「黑精靈」等。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [內有音樂和歌聲:「黑精靈」等。]

passages.original: [Exit Hecate.]
passages.vernacular: [赫卡忒下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [赫卡忒下。]

passages.title: Second Witch 第二女巫
passages.original: By the pricking of my thumbs, Something wicked this way comes. Open, locks, Whoever knocks!
passages.vernacular: 我拇指刺痛,有邪惡嘅嘢往呢邊嚟。開吧,鎖,無論邊個敲門!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我拇指刺痛,有邪惡的東西往這邊來。開吧,鎖,無論誰敲門!

passages.original: Enter Macbeth.
passages.vernacular: [馬克白上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [馬克白上。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: How now, you secret, black, and midnight hags! What is’t you do?
passages.vernacular: 點樣,你哋呢啲神秘、黑色、午夜嘅老妖婆!你哋喺做乜嘢?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 怎麼樣,你們這些神秘、黑色、午夜的老妖婆!你們在做什麼?

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: A deed without a name.
passages.vernacular: 一件冇名字嘅事。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 一件沒有名字的事。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: I conjure you, by that which you profess, (Howe’er you come to know it) answer me: Though you untie the winds, and let them fight Against the churches; though the yesty waves Confound and swallow navigation up; Though bladed corn be lodg’d, and trees blown down; Though castles topple on their warders’ heads; Though palaces and pyramids do slope Their heads to their foundations; though the treasure Of nature’s germens tumble all together, Even till destruction sicken, answer me To what I ask you.
passages.vernacular: 我憑你哋所信奉嘅嘢(無論你哋點樣得知佢)命令你哋回答我:縱使你哋鬆開風,讓風同教堂作戰;縱使泡沫翻湧嘅波浪把航船混亂吞冇;縱使成熟嘅麥子倒伏,樹被吹倒;縱使城堡喺守衛嘅頭上傾倒;縱使宮殿同金字塔向地基低下頭;縱使自然嘅種子寶庫全都滾喺一起,直到毀滅都厭倦喇,都請回答我所問你哋嘅。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我憑你們所信奉的東西(無論你們怎樣得知它)命令你們回答我:縱使你們鬆開風,讓風與教堂作戰;縱使泡沫翻湧的波浪把航船混亂吞沒;縱使成熟的麥子倒伏,樹被吹倒;縱使城堡在守衛的頭上傾倒;縱使宮殿和金字塔向地基低下頭;縱使自然的種子寶庫全都滾在一起,直到毀滅都厭倦了,也請回答我所問你們的。

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Speak.
passages.vernacular: 講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說。

passages.title: Second Witch 第二女巫
passages.original: Demand.
passages.vernacular: 問吧。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 問吧。

passages.title: Third Witch 第三女巫
passages.original: We’ll answer.
passages.vernacular: 我哋回答。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我們回答。

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Say, if thou’dst rather hear it from our mouths, Or from our masters?
passages.vernacular: 講,你寧願從我哋口中聽,定係從我哋嘅主人嗰度聽?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 說,你寧願從我們口中聽,還是從我們的主人那裡聽?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Call ’em, let me see ’em.
passages.vernacular: 召喚佢哋,讓我睇睇佢哋。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 召喚他們,讓我看看他們。

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Pour in sow’s blood, that hath eaten Her nine farrow; grease that’s sweaten From the murderer’s gibbet throw Into the flame.
passages.vernacular: 倒進母豬嘅血,牠食掉咗自己嘅九隻小豬;把從兇手絞架上滲出嘅油脂扔進火焰。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 倒進母豬的血,牠吃掉了自己的九隻小豬;把從兇手絞架上滲出的油脂扔進火焰。

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Come, high or low; Thyself and office deftly show!
passages.vernacular: 嚟吧,無論高低;巧妙地顯示你自己同你嘅職責!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 來吧,無論高低;巧妙地顯示你自己和你的職責!

passages.original: [Thunder. An Apparition of an armed Head rises.]
passages.vernacular: [雷聲。一個戴盔嘅人頭幻影升起。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雷聲。一個戴盔的人頭幻影升起。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Tell me, thou unknown power,—
passages.vernacular: 告訴我,你呢唔知名嘅力量——
passages.vernacularMandarin: 告訴我,你這不知名的力量——

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: He knows thy thought: Hear his speech, but say thou naught.
passages.vernacular: 佢知道你嘅念頭:聽佢講,但你乜嘢都唔好講。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他知道你的念頭:聽他說,但你什麼也別說。

passages.title: Apparition 幻影
passages.original: Macbeth! Macbeth! Macbeth! Beware Macduff; Beware the Thane of Fife.—Dismiss me.—Enough.
passages.vernacular: 馬克白!馬克白!馬克白!提防麥克德夫;提防法夫嘅領主。——放我走。——夠喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 馬克白!馬克白!馬克白!提防麥克德夫;提防法夫的領主。——放我走。——夠了。

passages.original: [Descends.]
passages.vernacular: [降下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [降下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Whate’er thou art, for thy good caution, thanks; Thou hast harp’d my fear aright.—But one word more.
passages.vernacular: 無論你係乜嘢,謝謝你嘅善意警告;你正確地彈中咗我嘅恐懼。——但仲有一句話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 無論你是什麼,謝謝你的善意警告;你正確地彈中了我的恐懼。——但還有一句話。

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: He will not be commanded. Here’s another, More potent than the first.
passages.vernacular: 佢唔肯受命。呢度有另一個,比第一個更有力。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他不肯受命。這裡有另一個,比第一個更有力。

passages.original: [Thunder. An Apparition of a bloody Child rises.]
passages.vernacular: [雷聲。一個流血細路嘅幻影升起。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雷聲。一個流血孩子的幻影升起。]

passages.title: Apparition 幻影
passages.original: Macbeth! Macbeth! Macbeth!
passages.vernacular: 馬克白!馬克白!馬克白!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 馬克白!馬克白!馬克白!

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Had I three ears, I’d hear thee.
passages.vernacular: 要係我有三隻耳朵,我就聽你。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要是我有三隻耳朵,我就聽你。

passages.title: Apparition 幻影
passages.original: Be bloody, bold, and resolute. Laugh to scorn The power of man, for none of woman born Shall harm Macbeth.
passages.vernacular: 要血腥、大膽、堅決。嘲笑人嘅力量,因為冇一個婦人所生嘅人會傷害馬克白。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要血腥、大膽、堅決。嘲笑人的力量,因為沒有一個婦人所生的人會傷害馬克白。

passages.original: [Descends.]
passages.vernacular: [降下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [降下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Then live, Macduff: what need I fear of thee? But yet I’ll make assurance double sure, And take a bond of fate. Thou shalt not live; That I may tell pale-hearted fear it lies, And sleep in spite of thunder.
passages.vernacular: 咁活住吧,麥克德夫:我有乜嘢好怕你嘅?不過我定係要使保證加倍穩固,向命運取一張契約。你唔能夠活;好讓我告訴臉色蒼白嘅恐懼佢喺講謊,並喺雷聲中安瞓。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那麼活著吧,麥克德夫:我有什麼好怕你的?不過我還是要使保證加倍穩固,向命運取一張契約。你不能活;好讓我告訴臉色蒼白的恐懼它在說謊,並在雷聲中安睡。

passages.original: [Thunder. An Apparition of a Child crowned, with a tree in his hand, rises.]
passages.vernacular: [雷聲。一個戴王冠、手持一棵樹嘅細路幻影升起。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雷聲。一個戴王冠、手持一棵樹的孩子幻影升起。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: What is this, That rises like the issue of a king, And wears upon his baby brow the round And top of sovereignty?
passages.vernacular: 呢個係乜嘢,像君王嘅後代般升起,喺佢嬰兒嘅額上戴住主權嘅圓冠頂飾?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 這是什麼,像君王的後代般升起,在他嬰兒的額上戴著主權的圓冠頂飾?

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Listen, but speak not to’t.
passages.vernacular: 聽住,但別對佢講話。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 聽著,但別對它說話。

passages.title: Apparition 幻影
passages.original: Be lion-mettled, proud, and take no care Who chafes, who frets, or where conspirers are: Macbeth shall never vanquish’d be, until Great Birnam wood to high Dunsinane hill Shall come against him.
passages.vernacular: 要有獅子嘅氣概、驕傲,別管邊個喺發怒、邊個喺焦慮、陰謀者喺邊度:馬克白永唔會被征服,直到偉大嘅勃南森林向高高嘅鄧西嫩山嚟攻打佢。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 要有獅子的氣概、驕傲,別管誰在發怒、誰在焦慮、陰謀者在哪裡:馬克白永不會被征服,直到偉大的勃南森林向高高的鄧西嫩山來攻打他。

passages.original: [Descends.]
passages.vernacular: [降下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [降下。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: That will never be: Who can impress the forest; bid the tree Unfix his earth-bound root? Sweet bodements, good! Rebellious head, rise never till the wood Of Birnam rise, and our high-plac’d Macbeth Shall live the lease of nature, pay his breath To time and mortal custom.—Yet my heart Throbs to know one thing: tell me, if your art Can tell so much, shall Banquo’s issue ever Reign in this kingdom?
passages.vernacular: 嗰永遠唔會發生:邊個能徵召森林;命令樹拔起佢紮根於地嘅根?甜蜜嘅預兆,好!叛逆嘅頭,除非勃南嘅森林升起,永唔好升起;而居高位嘅馬克白將活滿自然嘅租期,把佢嘅氣息還畀時間同世間嘅慣例。——不過我嘅心急切地想知道一件事:告訴我,如果你哋嘅法術能講咁多,班柯嘅後代會唔會有一天喺呢王國裡為王?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 那永遠不會發生:誰能徵召森林;命令樹拔起它紮根於地的根?甜蜜的預兆,好!叛逆的頭,除非勃南的森林升起,永不要升起;而居高位的馬克白將活滿自然的租期,把他的氣息還給時間和世間的慣例。——可是我的心急切地想知道一件事:告訴我,如果你們的法術能說這麼多,班柯的後代會不會有一天在這王國裡為王?

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Seek to know no more.
passages.vernacular: 唔好再追問喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 別再追問了。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: I will be satisfied: deny me this, And an eternal curse fall on you! Let me know. Why sinks that cauldron? and what noise is this?
passages.vernacular: 我要得到滿足:拒絕我,就讓永恆嘅詛咒降喺你哋身上!讓我知道。點解嗰口鍋沉下去喇?呢個係乜嘢聲音?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 我要得到滿足:拒絕我,就讓永恆的詛咒降在你們身上!讓我知道。為什麼那口鍋沉下去了?這是什麼聲音?

passages.original: [Hautboys.]
passages.vernacular: [雙簧管聲。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [雙簧管聲。]

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Show!
passages.vernacular: 顯現!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 顯現!

passages.title: Second Witch 第二女巫
passages.original: Show!
passages.vernacular: 顯現!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 顯現!

passages.title: Third Witch 第三女巫
passages.original: Show!
passages.vernacular: 顯現!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 顯現!

passages.title: All 眾人
passages.original: Show his eyes, and grieve his heart; Come like shadows, so depart!
passages.vernacular: 顯現畀佢嘅眼,傷佢嘅心;像影子般嚟,像影子般去!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 顯現給他的眼,傷他的心;像影子般來,像影子般去!

passages.original: [A show of eight kings appear, and pass over in order, the last with a glass in his hand; Banquo following.]
passages.vernacular: [八個國王嘅幻影出現,依次走過,最後一個手持一面鏡子;班柯跟隨其後。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [八個國王的幻影出現,依次走過,最後一個手持一面鏡子;班柯跟隨其後。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Thou are too like the spirit of Banquo. Down! Thy crown does sear mine eyeballs:—and thy hair, Thou other gold-bound brow, is like the first. A third is like the former.—Filthy hags! Why do you show me this?—A fourth!—Start, eyes! What, will the line stretch out to th’ crack of doom? Another yet!—A seventh!—I’ll see no more:— And yet the eighth appears, who bears a glass Which shows me many more; and some I see That twofold balls and treble sceptres carry. Horrible sight!—Now I see ’tis true; For the blood-bolter’d Banquo smiles upon me, And points at them for his.—What! is this so?
passages.vernacular: 你太像班柯嘅鬼魂喇。下去!你嘅王冠灼燒我嘅眼球:——仲有你嘅頭髮,你呢另一個金環額頭,同第一個一樣。第三個像前一個。——可恨嘅老妖婆!你哋點解畀我睇呢個?——第四個!——眼睛,跳出嚟吧!乜嘢,呢一脈要延伸到末日嘅霹靂嗎?又一個!——第七個!——我不睇喇:——不過第八個又出現,佢攞住一面鏡子,鏡子讓我睇見更多;我睇見有些人攞住雙重寶球同三重權杖。可怕嘅景象!——而家我睇出呢個係真嘅;因為滿頭血污嘅班柯對我微笑,並指住佢哋講係佢嘅子孫。——乜嘢!係咁樣嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你太像班柯的鬼魂了。下去!你的王冠灼燒我的眼球:——還有你的頭髮,你這另一個金環額頭,和第一個一樣。第三個像前一個。——可恨的老妖婆!你們為什麼給我看這個?——第四個!——眼睛,跳出來吧!什麼,這一脈要延伸到末日的霹靂嗎?又一個!——第七個!——我不看了:——可是第八個又出現,他拿著一面鏡子,鏡子讓我看見更多;我看見有些人拿著雙重寶球和三重權杖。可怕的景象!——現在我看出這是真的;因為滿頭血污的班柯對我微笑,並指著他們說是他的子孫。——什麼!是這樣嗎?

passages.title: First Witch 第一女巫
passages.original: Ay, sir, all this is so:—but why Stands Macbeth thus amazedly?— Come, sisters, cheer we up his sprites, And show the best of our delights. I’ll charm the air to give a sound, While you perform your antic round; That this great king may kindly say, Our duties did his welcome pay.
passages.vernacular: 對,先生,一切都係咁樣:——不過點解馬克白咁樣驚愕地站住?——嚟,姊妹哋,讓我哋使佢嘅精神振作,展示我哋最好嘅娛樂。我嚟施法讓空氣發出聲音,你哋跳你哋古怪嘅圈舞;好讓呢位偉大嘅國王親切地講,我哋嘅敬意已報答咗佢嘅歡迎。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 對,先生,一切都是這樣:——可是為什麼馬克白這樣驚愕地站著?——來,姊妹們,讓我們使他的精神振作,展示我們最好的娛樂。我來施法讓空氣發出聲音,你們跳你們古怪的圈舞;好讓這位偉大的國王親切地說,我們的敬意已報答了他的歡迎。

passages.original: [Music. The Witches dance, and vanish.]
passages.vernacular: [音樂。女巫哋跳舞,然後消失。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [音樂。女巫們跳舞,然後消失。]

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Where are they? Gone?—Let this pernicious hour Stand aye accursed in the calendar!— Come in, without there!
passages.vernacular: 佢哋喺邊度?走喇?——願呢惡毒嘅時辰喺日曆上永遠被詛咒!——外面嘅人,進嚟!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她們在哪裡?走了?——願這惡毒的時辰在日曆上永遠被詛咒!——外面的人,進來!

passages.original: Enter Lennox.
passages.vernacular: [倫諾克斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [倫諾克斯上。]

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: What’s your Grace’s will?
passages.vernacular: 陛下有何吩咐?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 陛下有何吩咐?

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Saw you the Weird Sisters?
passages.vernacular: 你睇見女巫姊妹咗嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你看見女巫姊妹了嗎?

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: No, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 冇,陛下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 沒有,陛下。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Came they not by you?
passages.vernacular: 佢哋冇從你身邊經過嗎?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 她們沒從你身邊經過嗎?

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: No, indeed, my lord.
passages.vernacular: 真嘅冇,陛下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 真的沒有,陛下。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Infected be the air whereon they ride; And damn’d all those that trust them!—I did hear The galloping of horse: who was’t came by?
passages.vernacular: 願佢哋所騎嘅空氣被傳染!所有相信佢哋嘅人都該被詛咒!——我聽到馬奔馳嘅聲音:係邊個經過?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 願她們所騎的空氣被傳染!所有相信她們的人都該被詛咒!——我聽到馬奔馳的聲音:是誰經過?

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: ’Tis two or three, my lord, that bring you word Macduff is fled to England.
passages.vernacular: 係兩三個人,陛下,佢哋帶嚟消息講麥克德夫逃到英格蘭去喇。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是兩三個人,陛下,他們帶來消息說麥克德夫逃到英格蘭去了。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Fled to England!
passages.vernacular: 逃到英格蘭!
passages.vernacularMandarin: 逃到英格蘭!

passages.title: Lennox 倫諾克斯
passages.original: Ay, my good lord.
passages.vernacular: 係,我嘅好陛下。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 是,我的好陛下。

passages.title: Macbeth 馬克白
passages.original: Time, thou anticipat’st my dread exploits: The flighty purpose never is o’ertook Unless the deed go with it. From this moment The very firstlings of my heart shall be The firstlings of my hand. And even now, To crown my thoughts with acts, be it thought and done: The castle of Macduff I will surprise; Seize upon Fife; give to th’ edge o’ th’ sword His wife, his babes, and all unfortunate souls That trace him in his line. No boasting like a fool; This deed I’ll do before this purpose cool: But no more sights!—Where are these gentlemen? Come, bring me where they are.
passages.vernacular: 時間,你搶先咗我可怕嘅行動:飄忽嘅意圖,除非行動隨之同行,永遠追不上。從呢一刻起,我心中最初嘅念頭將係我手中最初嘅行動。就從而家起,以行動為我嘅念頭加冕,想到就做到:我要突襲麥克德夫嘅城堡;奪取法夫;把佢嘅妻子、佢嘅細路,以及一切沿佢血脈追隨佢嘅不幸靈魂,都交畀刀鋒。唔好像傻瓜嗰樣誇口;呢件事我要喺呢意圖冷卻之前做成:但唔好再有幻象喇!——嗰啲先生哋喺邊度?嚟,帶我去佢哋喺嘅地方。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 時間,你搶先了我可怕的行動:飄忽的意圖,除非行動隨之同行,永遠追不上。從這一刻起,我心中最初的念頭將是我手中最初的行動。就從現在起,以行動為我的念頭加冕,想到就做到:我要突襲麥克德夫的城堡;奪取法夫;把他的妻子、他的孩子,以及一切沿他血脈追隨他的不幸靈魂,都交給刀鋒。不要像傻瓜那樣誇口;這件事我要在這意圖冷卻之前做成:但不要再有幻象了!——那些先生們在哪裡?來,帶我去他們在的地方。

passages.original: [Exeunt.]
passages.vernacular: [同下。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [同下。]

chapters.title: Act IV, Scene II — Fife. Macduff’s Castle 第四幕第二場:法夫,麥克德夫城堡

passages.original: Enter Lady Macduff her Son and Ross.
passages.vernacular: [麥克德夫夫人、佢嘅兒子同羅斯上。]
passages.vernacularMandarin: [麥克德夫夫人、她的兒子和羅斯上。]

passages.title: Lady Macduff 麥克德夫夫人
passages.original: What had he done, to make him fly the land?
passages.vernacular: 佢做咗乜嘢,要逃離國土?
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他做了什麼,要逃離國土?

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: You must have patience, madam.
passages.vernacular: 夫人,您必須忍耐。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 夫人,您必須忍耐。

passages.title: Lady Macduff 麥克德夫夫人
passages.original: He had none: His flight was madness: when our actions do not, Our fears do make us traitors.
passages.vernacular: 佢冇忍耐:佢嘅逃亡係瘋狂:當我哋嘅行動唔能夠,我哋嘅恐懼使我哋成為叛徒。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 他沒有忍耐:他的逃亡是瘋狂:當我們的行動不能,我們的恐懼使我們成為叛徒。

passages.title: Ross 羅斯
passages.original: You know not Whether it was his wisdom or his fear.
passages.vernacular: 你唔知道嗰個係佢嘅智慧定係佢嘅恐懼。
passages.vernacularMandarin: 你不知道那是他的智慧還是他的恐懼。

passages.title: Lady Macduff 麥克德夫夫人
passages.original: Wisdom! to leave his wife, to leave his babes, His mansion, and his titles, in a place From whence himself does fly? He loves us not: He wants the natural touch; for the poor wren, The most diminutive of birds, will fight, Her young ones in her nest, against the owl. All is the fear, and nothing is the love; As little is the wisdom, where the flight So runs against all reason.
